news.title: Henderson on a ‘vital’ three points and ‘controlled’ performance
news.title_zh: 亨德森谈“至关重要的”三分和“可控”的表现
news.body_en: Jordan Henderson was delighted to continue building momentum by recording back-to-back Premier League victories, with a first clean sheet in that competition to boot. Having brushed Bournemouth aside with an emphatic 5-1 victory at Stamford Bridge last week, Chelsea took that form on the road to inflict Everton’s first defeat of 2026/27, that 2-0 win also our first ever at their new Hill Dickinson Stadium home. With consecutive league wins in our pocket, which lifted us above the Toffees and into fourth in the Premier League standings, Henderson was left understandably satisfied with a job well done by the Blues on Merseyside on Saturday. ‘I thought it was a good performance and a good result in the end,’ said the midfielder. ‘Three points is always vital for us, especially away from home against a tough team who were unbeaten this season. ‘We knew it was going to be a difficult game, but I really liked the performance. I thought defensively we looked solid and we created some good chances to score two nice goals. Overall, I think it was a good day. ‘We wanted to back up last week by going there and putting on a good performance and getting the win, which we did.’ That sense of satisfaction is only enhanced by the feeling that Chelsea are finding the balance that Xabi Alonso had called for, by adding defensive steel to our free-scoring attack, with seven goals scored to one conceded across our last two matches after Saturday’s shut-out. ‘A clean sheet is always important and I know we haven't had enough of them for a while,’ he continued. ‘So to get one is nice, but I thought that overall our defending from start to finish was good. ‘I don't think we gave them too many chances at all, so that was really pleasing. We could have maybe scored one or two more goals, but overall I thought we controlled the game well and it's just about keep building and keep working.’ Henderson also had words of support for Emiliano Martinez, who was stretchered off the field against Everton and later underwent successful surgery on a fractured jaw, wishing our goalkeeper a speedy recovery. ‘All the lads and everyone will be thinking of him, of course, and texting him. So fingers crossed he can be back with us pretty soon because he's a really important figure, not only on the pitch but around the dressing room.’ Now the focus turns to our next huge clash at Stamford Bridge! Get ready for derby day as we take on London rivals Tottenham Hotspur. Elevate your matchday with Club Chelsea - exclusive VIP experiences on sale now.
news.body_zh: 乔丹·亨德森很高兴能够通过连续两场英超联赛的胜利来继续积聚动力，并在这场比赛中首次保持零失球。上周在斯坦福桥以 5-1 的比分大胜伯恩茅斯后，切尔西以这样的状态在客场击败了埃弗顿，这是 2026/27 赛季的首场失利，这场 2-0 的胜利也是我们在他们的新主场希尔迪金森球场的第一次胜利。我们在联赛中连续获胜，使我们超越太妃糖，在英超积分榜上排名第四，亨德森对蓝军周六在默西塞德郡的出色表现感到满意，这是可以理解的。 “我认为这是一场很好的表现，最终也取得了很好的结果，”这位中场球员说道。 “三分对我们来说始终至关重要，尤其是客场对阵一支本赛季不败的强队。 “我们知道这将是一场艰难的比赛，但我真的很喜欢这场比赛。我认为我们的防守看起来很稳固，我们创造了一些很好的机会，打进了两个漂亮的进球。总的来说，我认为这是美好的一天。 “我们希望上周能够回到那里，打出良好的表现并赢得胜利，我们做到了。”这种满足感只会因为切尔西找到了哈比·阿隆索所要求的平衡而增强，通过在我们的自由得分进攻中增加防守钢铁，在周六停赛后的最后两场比赛中我们打进了 7 球，丢了 1 球。 “零失球总是很重要，我知道我们已经有一段时间没有失球了，”他继续说道。 “所以得到一个很好，但我认为总的来说我们从开始到结束的防守都很好。 “我认为我们根本没有给他们太多机会，所以这真的很令人高兴。我们本来可以再进一两个球，但总的来说，我认为我们很好地控制了比赛，只是继续建设和继续努力。”亨德森还对埃米利亚诺·马丁内斯表示了支持。埃米利亚诺·马丁内斯在对阵埃弗顿的比赛中被担架抬离场，后来成功接受了下巴骨折的手术，祝愿我们的门将早日康复。 “当然，所有的小伙子和每个人都会想着他，并给他发短信。所以祈祷他很快就能回到我们身边，因为他是一个非常重要的人物，不仅在球场上，而且在更衣室里。”现在焦点转向我们在斯坦福桥的下一场重大冲突！为德比日做好准备，我们将迎战伦敦对手托特纳姆热刺队。与切尔西俱乐部一起提升您的比赛日 - 独家 VIP 体验现已发售。

news.title: Cuthbert on her return and 'ruthless' Bompastor
news.title_zh: 卡斯伯特回归和“无情”的邦帕斯特
news.body_en: Chelsea captain Erin Cuthbert was delighted to make her return from injury during our 6-2 win over Tottenham Hotspur at Stamford Bridge on Sunday afternoon. The skipper, who has been working her way back to fitness after a knee problem sustained while on international duty in June, was given a rousing reception by the Blues supporters when she was introduced after an hour on Sunday. Cuthbert took over the armband from previous captain Millie Bright back in August, but had to wait until our 10th match of the campaign to make her first appearance since the news was announced. Call it good fortune or merely a coincidence, but Lauren James scored our third goal only a minute after her introduction, with Sjoeke Nusken following up with our fourth shortly afterwards. 'It was a bit mental, a bit chaotic!' said Cuthbert afterwards. 'I came on, and we scored quite early, so that kind of settled the nerves a little bit. 'It's always tough to come in during a high-pressure game, but I loved every minute of being back on the pitch, and back at Stamford Bridge. When we're playing like that, it's a fun place.' It has been four-and-a-half months of intense rehab work for Cuthbert to regain match fitness and now she is back she understands that she will have to earn her place in the team. 'Honestly, I felt so ready,' the midfielder continued. 'I had a few set-backs here and there during the recovery. I was targeting the start of the season, and it's five weeks in now, so that's how it went for me. 'I've been working hard in the background. It can be hard to be out when the team are doing really well, and although it's great to watch, I just want to be out there helping the team. 'We've got a single game week this week, and no one is going to know what to do with themselves. The competition is going to be high in training. We will have to perform if we want a place in the starting line-up, and that's what you want as a player. 'That's why I've been at a club like Chelsea for so long because I enjoy the competition. We've got so many really good players in the midfield and across the pitch competing in other positions, and I really thrive under pressure. 'Today it was about me coming on and trying to make an impact, and I got booked, so that's one way to make an impact!' Cuthbert went on to detail exactly how head coach Sonia Bompastor drives the standards among the team, and how hard the players have to work to meet her expectations. 'I don't envy the manager's decision because she's got 25 international players to manage, and that's her job,' the captain explained. 'As players, we've got to make her job as hard as we possibly can, and over the course of the season, we are going to need everybody. 'We've got some real tough spells coming up. I think we've got another eight games in this block before the next international break so everybody will get their moment and it's about being ready to take it when it comes. 'Sonia demands standards in training every single day. She pushes you. She wants the best from her team, and she's ruthless. She wants a high press every single second. And if she doesn't get it from the people on the pitch, she'll get it from the people sitting on the side.'
news.body_zh: 周日下午，切尔西队长艾琳·库斯伯特很高兴在斯坦福桥 6-2 战胜托特纳姆热刺队的比赛中伤愈复出。这位队长在六月的国际比赛中膝盖受伤，一直在努力恢复健康，周日一个小时后，当她被介绍时，受到了蓝军支持者的热烈欢迎。卡斯伯特在八月份从前任队长米莉·布莱特手中接过了队长袖标，但直到我们本赛季的第10场比赛，她才在消息宣布后首次亮相。可以说这是好运，也可以说只是巧合，但劳伦·詹姆斯 (Lauren James) 在登场后仅一分钟就攻入了我们的第三个进球，不久之后，斯乔克·努斯肯 (Sjoeke Nusken) 也攻入了我们的第四个进球。 “这有点精神错乱，有点混乱！”卡斯伯特事后说道。 “我上场了，我们很早就进球了，所以这稍微缓解了我们的紧张情绪。 “在一场高压的比赛中上场总是很困难，但我喜欢回到球场上、回到斯坦福桥的每一分钟。当我们像那样玩耍时，这是一个有趣的地方。”卡斯伯特经过四个半月的紧张康复工作才恢复了比赛状态，现在她回来了，她明白自己必须在球队中赢得一席之地。 “老实说，我感觉自己已经准备好了，”这位中场球员继续说道。 “在康复过程中，我时不时地遇到了一些挫折。我的目标是赛季开始，现在已经五周了，所以这就是我的情况。 “我一直在后台努力工作。当球队表现非常出色时，很难离开，尽管观看比赛很精彩，但我只想上场帮助球队。 “这周我们只有一场比赛，没有人知道自己该怎么办。比赛的训练强度将会很高。如果我们想在首发阵容中占有一席之地，我们就必须表现出色，这就是作为一名球员所想要的。 “这就是为什么我在切尔西这样的俱乐部呆了这么久，因为我喜欢比赛。我们在中场和球场上有很多非常优秀的球员，在其他位置上竞争，我真的在压力下茁壮成长。 “今天我上场并试图产生影响，但我得到了黄牌，所以这是产生影响的一种方式！”卡斯伯特接着详细介绍了主教练索尼娅·邦帕斯特如何推动球队的标准，以及球员们必须付出多大的努力才能达到她的期望。 “我并不羡慕主教练的决定，因为她要管理 25 名国际球员，这就是她的工作，”队长解释道。 “作为球员，我们必须让她的工作尽可能地努力，在整个赛季中，我们将需要每个人。 “我们即将面临一些真正艰难的时期。我认为在下一次国际比赛日之前我们还有八场比赛，所以每个人都会得到属于自己的时刻，并且要在它到来时做好准备。 “索尼娅每天都要求训练有标准。她推你。她希望她的团队做到最好，而且她很无情。她希望每一秒都受到高压。如果她不能从球场上的人那里得到它，她就会从坐在一边的人那里得到它。

news.title: Bompastor gives Girma update and praises 'unbelievable' Chelsea fans
news.title_zh: 邦帕斯特向吉尔马通报了最新情况，并赞扬了“令人难以置信的”切尔西球迷
news.body_en: Sonia Bompastor was delighted with her side after Chelsea Women's 6-2 win over Tottenham Hotspur at Stamford Bridge on Sunday afternoon and singled out the impact of the supporters on the team's performance. A brace each from Ellie Carpenter and Lauren James, plus goals from substitutes Maika Hamano and Sjoeke Nusken, contributed to the 6-2 victory on Bompastor's 50th game in the Women's Super League. The result means we continue our unbeaten start to the campaign, with five wins and one draw from our opening six league matches this season. 'I'm pleased with the performance and the result,' said the head coach afterwards. 'I was convinced coming into this game, we would need players who would come in and bring a big impact and fresh legs. 'On the back of the international break, we can talk about the tactical aspects, but it was probably the most important thing to have players who impacted the game the way they did today. So it's good when you have depth in the squad, a lot of players available, and the quality of the players who are coming in.' The fans at Stamford Bridge were treated to a big win for Chelsea on Sunday afternoon, with eight goals scored in total. We are now playing all of our WSL matches at Stamford Bridge and the crowd noise has been excellent throughout. That sentiment was echoed by our head coach. 'The atmosphere today was great in the stadium,' continued Bompastor. 'The fans were unbelievable. It helps when they can see many goals. Both teams need to play well for them to see the quality of football on the pitch. So credit to Chelsea, but also to Tottenham for that. 'I feel like they really enjoyed it, especially with the win at the end and the three points.' Naomi Girma was missing from the squad against Spurs, and Bompastor gave an update on her condition. 'Naomi picked up a small injury in her calf before the international break,' she explained. 'That's why she's out of the squad. But right now I have depth in the squad. I have a lot of high-quality competition.' Praising the contribution of James after her two superb goals this afternoon, Bompastor said: 'When LJ is playing at this level, we are talking about a top-class player, a world-class player. She creates things for herself by herself with the quality she has on the ball. 'It's a big help when you have a player who can create from nothing. I want to also highlight the team performance. When individuals are performing, it's usually because the team is performing as well. The players around her are doing a job for her to express her quality on the ball.' James came into Sunday's clash on the back of a brace for England during Tuesday evening's 5-0 win over Greece. Bompastor explained that her international performances helped fuel today's outstanding display. 'It was a bit more difficult for her before the international break,' said the head coach. 'Going with England was a big boost and I think she played really well, and we are now getting the benefit of that, so it's good.'
news.body_zh: 周日下午切尔西女足在斯坦福桥以 6-2 战胜托特纳姆热刺队后，索尼娅·邦帕斯特对她的球队感到高兴，并特别指出了球迷对球队表现的影响。艾莉·卡彭特和劳伦·詹姆斯分别梅开二度，加上替补球员滨野麦卡和斯乔克·努斯肯的进球，帮助邦帕斯托在女子超级联赛的第 50 场比赛中以 6-2 获胜。这个结果意味着我们继续保持赛季不败的开局，本赛季前六场联赛取得五胜一平。 “我对表现和结果感到满意，”主教练赛后说道。 “我确信参加这场比赛，我们需要能够带来巨大影响和新鲜血液的球员。 “在国际比赛日结束后，我们可以讨论战术方面的问题，但拥有像今天这样影响比赛的球员可能是最重要的事情。因此，当你的球队有深度、有很多可用的球员以及新加入的球员的质量时，这是件好事。”周日下午，斯坦福桥的球迷们见证了切尔西队的一场重大胜利，总共打进了八个进球。现在我们所有的 WSL 比赛都在斯坦福桥进行，整个过程中人群的喧闹声非常好。我们的主教练也表达了同样的观点。 “今天体育场内的气氛非常好，”邦帕斯特继续说道。 “球迷们难以置信。当他们看到很多目标时，这会有所帮助。两支球队都需要打好比赛才能看到球场上足球的质量。这要归功于切尔西，也归功于托特纳姆热刺。 “我觉得他们真的很享受比赛，尤其是最后的胜利和三分。”娜奥米·吉尔玛在对阵热刺的比赛中缺席，邦帕斯特通报了她的最新情况。 “国际比赛日之前，内奥米的小腿受了点小伤，”她解释道。 “这就是她被排除在球队之外的原因。但现在我在球队中有深度。我有很多高质量的竞争。庞帕斯特在今天下午打进两粒精彩进球后赞扬了詹姆斯的贡献，他说：“当LJ打出这样的水平时，我们谈论的是一位顶级球员，一位世界级球员。她凭借自己的球技为自己创造了东西。 “当你拥有一名能够从无到有创造的球员时，这是一个很大的帮助。我还想强调团队的表现。当个人表现出色时，通常是因为团队也在表现出色。她周围的球员正在为她做一份工作，让她展现她的球技。”周二晚上英格兰队5-0战胜希腊队的比赛中，詹姆斯梅开二度，参加了周日的比赛。邦帕斯托解释说，她在国际比赛中的表现有助于推动今天的出色表现。 “国际比赛日之前对她来说有点困难，”主教练说。 “与英格兰队一起比赛是一个很大的推动，我认为她踢得非常好，我们现在正在从中受益，所以这很好。”

news.title: Match report: Chelsea Women 6-2 Tottenham
news.title_zh: 比赛战报：切尔西女足 6-2 托特纳姆热刺
news.body_en: A brilliant second-half performance saw Chelsea Women defeat Tottenham Hotspur 6-2 at Stamford Bridge, with a brace each from Ellie Carpenter and Lauren James. Tottenham came into the encounter in good form, aside from a heavy defeat to London City Lionesses before the international break. And early on, they showed exactly why they had risen to fourth in the table as they played with determination from the get-go. Yet it was Chelsea who took the lead thanks to a brilliant solo effort from Lauren James, as she used her skill to drive to the byline and fire a perfect shot over the line from what first looked to be an impossible angle. Away sides often let their heads drop when the Blues take the lead at home, but Spurs stuck to their plan, kept pushing forward and got their reward when Matilda Vinberg headed in from close range. The second half was a different story. A fine finish from Ellie Carpenter put the Blues back in front before another outstanding solo effort from James gave us breathing room with an hour gone. Substitute Sjoeke Nusken smashed in emphatically following some excellent wing play from Alyssa Thompson, before Maika Hamano netted against her former club with a stunning strike from range. Tottenham pulled back a consolation goal with three minutes of normal time remaining, before Carpenter completed her brace with composure in stoppage time. It was a positive day all around for the Blues, as the big win coincided with the first minutes this season for new club captain Erin Cuthbert as she came on after an hour. This Chelsea side seems to be looking more impressive every week. Bompastor made four alterations to her line-up, exchanging Sandy Baltimore, Veerle Buurman, Hamano and Nusken for James, Katie McCabe, Lexi Potter and Thompson. It was Spurs who started on the front foot in the opening minutes, and Hannah Hampton had to be alert and make a save when the space suddenly opened up for Signe Gaupset in a central position. But then the Blues had a chance of our own as Carpenter drove to the byline and put a dangerous ball in across the byline. Striker Melvine Malard received the cross no more than a yard out, but with her back to goal just couldn't steer the ball across the line. Spurs had come to Stamford Bridge ready to fight for every ball. After 15 minutes, there was not much between the sides and the possession counter read at 50 per cent each. With a determined Spurs making things difficult, it took a magnificent solo effort from James to unlock their defence. Stealing the ball from Toko Koga on the left flank, our No10 drove towards the dead-ball line. Most players would've run out of space at the by-line, but not James. Instead, she unleashed a shot with sublime skill and pure power, beating the goalkeeper as the ball crossed the line in the opposite corner. Yet Spurs were undeterred. Kadeisha Buchanan made a key intervention from a Vinberg cross, preventing the ball from reaching the onrushing Cathinka Tandberg as they continued to press forward towards goal. Koga had recovered her composure from losing the ball to James as she made a key block on Carpenter up the other end. Tottenham's persistence paid off shortly before half-time. Arriving late into the final third, Julie Blakstad picked up the ball just outside the penalty area, swinging a cross into the far post. Vinberg rose highest, nodding home from close range to put the visitors level. Spurs came out brightly once again in the second half, but the best chance in the early stages of the second half fell to Chelsea. Lexi Potter's determination in midfield and pass to Malard created an opening for the striker, but her curling effort from the corner of the penalty area went over the bar. Just when the outcome of the contest looked uncertain, Thompson used her pace to breeze past her marker, skipping over a challenge on the edge of the box before squaring the ball to Carpenter. The Australian made no mistake with her powerful finish high into the back of the net, putting the Blues back in front in style. Bompastor then made a triple change. Among the substitutes was Cuthbert, making her first appearance for Chelsea this season, and our new captain received a rousing reception from the Blues supporters in the stands at Stamford Bridge. Cuthbert had been on the pitch for less than a couple of minutes when James took matters into her own hands again. Breaking free of the backpedalling defenders, she burst into the box and used her low centre of gravity to lean backwards and curl another superb shot into the bottom corner. After what had been a truly difficult contest, Chelsea then found yet another gear. Keira Walsh chipped a delicate pass to substitute Nusken, who had found space in the box, and the midfielder lashed in a powerful strike to put us 4-1 in front. The Germany international then almost handed James her hat-trick, but grateful goalkeeper Lize Kop was able to dive on the ball and just about prevent her shot from crossing the line. Spurs proved dangerous in attack once again when Hampton made an excellent save from a Kirsty Hanson shot, and showed the quickest reactions when she collected the follow-up. Facing her former club for the first time since last season's loan spell, Hamano said before the match that her dream is to one day win the prestigious Ballon d'Or trophy. Her 86th-minute strike was certainly worthy of a player of that calibre, netting with a magnificent swerving effort from almost 30 yards out. Those inside the stadium were still recovering from Hamano's brilliant effort when Spurs grabbed a consolation through Gaupset, but there was still more to come from the Blues. The emphatic London derby win was sealed when Walsh picked out Carpenter in the box, and the wing-back then completed her brace with a wonderful turn and finish. A brilliantly entertaining afternoon for the Chelsea faithful at the Bridge. We go top of the WSL table, pending Manchester City's result. We face newly-promoted Crystal Palace in Women's Super League action over at the Borough Sports Ground in Sutton. news.body_zh: 下半场，切尔西女足凭借埃莉·卡彭特和劳伦·詹姆斯的梅开二度，在斯坦福桥以 6-2 击败托特纳姆热刺队。托特纳姆热刺队在这场比赛中状态良好，除了在国际比赛日之前惨败于伦敦城狮队之外。早些时候，他们从一开始就表现出了坚定的决心，从而准确地展示了自己为何能升至积分榜第四。然而，切尔西凭借劳伦·詹姆斯的出色个人表现取得了领先，她利用自己的技术冲向底线，从最初看起来不可能的角度射出一脚完美的射门。当蓝军在主场取得领先时，客队常常会低头，但热刺坚持他们的计划，不断向前推进，并在玛蒂尔达·文伯格近距离头球破门时得到了回报。下半场则是一个不同的故事。艾莉·卡彭特 (Ellie Carpenter) 的精彩射门让蓝军重新回到领先位置，而詹姆斯的另一次出色的个人射门则在一个小时后给了我们喘息的空间。替补球员斯乔克·努斯肯 (Sjoeke Nusken) 在阿丽莎·汤普森 (Alyssa Thompson) 的侧翼出色表现后大力进球，随后滨野麦卡 (Maika Hamano) 凭借一记令人惊叹的远射破门，对阵她的前东家。托特纳姆热刺队在比赛还剩三分钟时扳回一球，扳平比分，卡彭特在补时阶段冷静地完成梅开二度。对于蓝军来说，这是积极的一天，因为这场巨大的胜利恰逢新俱乐部队长艾琳·卡斯伯特本赛季的第一分钟，她在一小时后上场。这支切尔西队似乎每周都显得更加令人印象深刻。邦帕斯特对阵容进行了四次调整，将桑迪·巴尔的摩、维尔勒·布尔曼、哈马诺和努斯肯换成了詹姆斯、凯蒂·麦凯布、莱克西·波特和汤普森。热刺在开场几分钟就取得了领先，当中路的西格涅·高普塞特突然腾出空间时，汉娜·汉普顿必须保持警惕并做出扑救。但随后蓝军获得了自己的机会，卡彭特带球冲向底线，将一记危险的球打入底线。前锋梅尔文·马拉德在离球门不到一码的地方接到传中，但她背对着球门，无法将球带过球门线。热刺来到斯坦福桥已经做好了争夺每一个球的准备。 15分钟后，双方的攻势不多，控球率都显示为50%。由于意志坚定的马刺队让事情变得困难，詹姆斯依靠自己的出色个人努力来解开他们的防守。我们的 10 号球员从左翼的古贺东子 (Toko Koga) 处断球，冲向死球线。大多数球员都会在边线耗尽空间，但詹姆斯不会。相反，她以高超的技巧和纯粹的力量射出一脚射门，当球越过球门线时，她击败了门将。然而热刺并没有被吓倒。卡德沙·布坎南 (Kadeisha Buchanan) 在文伯格 (Vinberg) 传中进行了关键干预，阻止了皮球到达冲上来的卡辛卡·坦德伯格 (Cathinka Tandberg)，同时他们继续向球门推进。科加在球输给詹姆斯后恢复了镇定，她在另一端对卡彭特进行了关键的拦截。托特纳姆热刺的坚持在半场结束前不久得到了回报。进入最后三分之一时，朱莉·布拉克斯塔德在禁区外接球，将球传向远门柱。文伯格站得最高，近距离点头致胜，将客队扳平。下半场热刺再次亮眼，但下半场初期最好的机会落到了切尔西身上。莱克西·波特在中场的决心和传球给马拉德为前锋创造了机会，但她在禁区角的弧线射门却高出了横梁。就在比赛结果看起来不确定时，汤普森利用自己的速度轻松越过了盯防者，跳过了禁区边缘的挑战，然后将球传给了卡彭特。这位澳大利亚人没有犯任何错误，她的强力射门高射入网，让蓝军重新回到领先位置。 Bompastor 随后进行了三次更改。替补球员中包括库斯伯特，这是她本赛季首次代表切尔西出场，我们的新队长在斯坦福桥的看台上受到了蓝军球迷的热烈欢迎。当詹姆斯再次亲自处理此事时，库斯伯特在球场上待了不到几分钟。 她挣脱了后退的防守队员，冲入禁区，利用自己的低重心向后倾斜，将另一记精彩的射门打入底角。经过一场真正艰难的比赛后，切尔西找到了另一个装备。凯拉·沃尔什 (Keira Walsh) 巧妙传球给在禁区内找到空档的努斯肯 (Nusken)，这位中场球员大力射门，我们以 4-1 领先。这位德国国脚随后差点让詹姆斯上演帽子戏法，但心怀感激的门将莉泽·科普(Lize Kop)扑向皮球，差点阻止她的射门越过球门线。当汉普顿对科斯蒂·汉森的射门做出精彩扑救时，热刺再次证明了进攻的危险性，并在她接到后续球时表现出了最快的反应。这是自上赛季租借以来第一次面对她的老东家，滨野在赛前表示，她的梦想是有一天赢得久负盛名的金球奖奖杯。她在第 86 分钟的进球无疑是配得上这样水平的球员的，她在近 30 码外的一脚漂亮的转身射门进球。当热刺通过高普塞特获得安慰时，体育场内的人们还没有从滨野的出色表现中恢复过来，但蓝军还有更多的东西要做。当沃尔什在禁区内挑衅卡彭特时，伦敦德比的胜利就已经锁定了，而这位边后卫则以精彩的转身和射门完成了梅开二度。对于蓝桥的切尔西球迷来说，这是一个精彩有趣的下午。我们在 WSL 积分榜上名列前茅，等待曼城的结果。我们在萨顿自治市体育场举行的女足超级联赛比赛中将对阵新晋级的水晶宫队。切尔西：汉普顿、卡彭特、青铜（c）（比约恩 68）、布坎南、麦凯布、卡普坦（滨野 60）、沃尔什、波特（库斯伯特 61）、詹姆斯（比弗-琼斯 72）、汤普森、马拉德（努斯肯 61）未上场替补：彭、布尔曼、德拉戈尼、巴尔的摩得分手：詹姆斯 25、62、卡彭特58、90+1、努斯肯 67、滨野 86 news.title: Confirmed Chelsea Women line up vs Tottenham
news.title_zh: 确认切尔西女足对阵托特纳姆热刺的阵容
news.body_en: Sonia Bompastor has made four changes to her Chelsea side for our Women's Super League match against Tottenham Hotspur at Stamford Bridge this lunch-time. The head coach confirmed in her pre-match press conference that she had no injury issues to contend with, and she has been able to rotate her line-up after a busy international break for our players. Katie McCabe comes in for Veerle Buurman in defence and Lexi Potter, following her senior England debut last Tuesday, replaces Sjoeke Nusken in the XI. Up front, Lauren James - who scored a brace for the Lionesses on Tuesday - replaces Maika Hamano, while Alyssa Thompson is switched for Sandy Baltimore. Club captain Erin Cuthbert is on the bench, having played the full second half in Scotland's 3-2 win over Czechia in midweek. Chelsea: Hampton, Carpenter, Bronze (c), Buchanan, McCabe, Kaptein, Walsh, Potter, James, Thompson, Malard Chelsea substitutes: Peng, Bjorn, Buurman, Cuthbert, Nusken, Dragoni, Hamano, Baltimore, Beever-Jones
news.body_zh: 索尼娅·邦帕斯托 (Sonia Bompastor) 对她的切尔西队在午餐时间斯坦福桥对阵托特纳姆热刺队的女足超级联赛中做出了四项调整。主教练在赛前新闻发布会上证实，她没有需要应对的伤病问题，并且在我们球员忙碌的国际比赛日结束后，她已经能够轮换阵容。凯蒂·麦凯布 (Katie McCabe) 接替维尔勒·布尔曼 (Veerle Buurman) 担任后卫，莱克西·波特 (Lexi Potter) 在上周二完成英格兰国家队首秀后，取代了斯乔克·努斯肯 (Sjoeke Nusken) 进入首发阵容。在锋线上，劳伦·詹姆斯（Lauren James）在周二为雌狮队梅开二度，取代了麦卡·哈马诺（Maika Hamano），而阿丽莎·汤普森（Alyssa Thompson）则换成了桑迪·巴尔的摩（Sandy Baltimore）。俱乐部队长艾琳·库斯伯特坐在替补席上，她在周中苏格兰 3-2 战胜捷克队的比赛中打满了下半场。切尔西：汉普顿、卡彭特、青铜（中）、布坎南、麦凯布、卡普坦、沃尔什、波特、詹姆斯、汤普森、马拉德切尔西替补：彭、比约恩、布尔曼、库斯伯特、努斯肯、德拉戈尼、哈马诺、巴尔的摩、比弗-琼斯

news.title: Hato on Cobham work paying off with ‘solid’ clean sheet
news.title_zh: 哈托谈科巴姆的工作以“扎实”的零失球获得回报
news.body_en: Jorrel Hato was pleased to see the hard work put in on the training pitch in recent weeks come to fruition with an important win at Everton, which he believes provides a strong platform to continue building on. A brace of goals by Pedro Neto at either end of the second half secured our first-ever three points at the Hill Dickinson Stadium and moved us up to fourth place in the Premier League table with a 2-0 victory over the Toffees. However, just as important as the winning goals was the clean sheet at the other end of the pitch, our first in the league of 2026/27 under Xabi Alonso. Speaking after the win, Hato confirmed that shut-out was a key aim for the Blues going into this game and something they had been working hard to achieve on the training pitch at Cobham recently. ‘That was one of our goals,’ said the defender. ‘Of course, we score a lot of goals, everyone knows this, but now we finally have our own clean sheet and as a team it's good. ‘We didn't give many chances away, or big chances, so that's solid and we keep going. Now we have to go forward with it and keep as many clean sheets as we can. ‘When we came back from the international break, everyone knew that we have a good team and we score a lot of goals, but defensively it had to be better. We had to do it, and I think we showed it against Bournemouth and again against Everton.’ That clean sheet arrived despite the loss of Emiliano Martinez during the second half to a nasty injury, with it being confirmed this morning that our goalkeeper has now undergone successful surgery on a fractured jaw. ‘Of course, when a moment like this happens, everyone is in shock. But of course, the game goes on for another 20 minutes. So we were just saying to each other: “stay focused”. I think we did a good job. We scored to make it 2-0 and finish off the game.’ Despite the set-back of losing Martinez, it was a strong second-half showing from the Blues on Merseyside to claim all the points and leapfrog opponents Everton in the standings. Now, Hato is looking to keep building on the momentum from that victory and the previous week’s win over Bournemouth, with a London derby against Tottenham Hotspur at Stamford Bridge to come next. ‘I think we started well after the break, and now it’s two games and two wins, so we have to keep going,’ the Dutchman added. ‘There are a lot of games coming, and great games to play as well, so we have to keep going.’ Now the focus turns to our next huge clash at Stamford Bridge! news.body_zh: 乔雷尔·哈托很高兴看到最近几周在训练场上的努力取得了成果，在埃弗顿取得了一场重要的胜利，他相信这为继续前进提供了一个强大的平台。佩德罗·内托在下半场两端的梅开二度帮助我们在希尔迪金森体育场获得了首个三分，并以 2-0 战胜太妃糖队，将英超积分榜提升至第四位。然而，与致胜进球同样重要的是球场另一端的零失球，这是我们在哈维·阿隆索的带领下在 2026/27 赛季联赛中的第一次零失球。获胜后，哈托证实，锁定胜局是蓝军进入这场比赛的一个关键目标，也是他们最近在科巴姆训练场上努力实现的目标。 “这是我们的目标之一，”后卫说。 “当然，我们进了很多球，每个人都知道这一点，但现在我们终于有了自己的零失球，作为一支球队，这很好。 `我们没有放弃很多机会，也没有放弃大机会，所以这很稳固，我们会继续前进。现在我们必须继续前进，并尽可能多地保持不失球。 “当我们从国际比赛日回来时，每个人都知道我们有一支优秀的球队，我们进了很多球，但在防守上必须做得更好。我们必须这么做，我认为我们在对阵伯恩茅斯和对阵埃弗顿的比赛中都展示了这一点。尽管埃米利亚诺·马丁内斯在下半场因严重受伤而失去了比赛，但我们还是取得了不失球的成绩，今天早上证实我们的门将已经成功接受了下巴骨折的手术。 “当然，当这样的时刻发生时，每个人都会感到震惊。当然，比赛还要继续20分钟。所以我们只是对彼此说：“保持专注”。我认为我们做得很好。我们进球了，2-0 结束了比赛。尽管失去了马丁内斯，蓝军在下半场表现出色，在默西塞德郡取得了全部积分，并在积分榜上超越了对手埃弗顿。现在，哈托希望继续利用这场胜利和上周战胜伯恩茅斯的势头，接下来将在斯坦福桥与托特纳姆热刺队进行伦敦德比。 “我认为我们在中场休息后开局不错，现在是两场比赛和两场胜利，所以我们必须继续前进，”荷兰人补充道。 “还有很多比赛即将到来，还有精彩的比赛要打，所以我们必须继续前进。”现在焦点转向我们在斯坦福桥的下一场重大比赛！为德比日做好准备，我们将迎战伦敦对手托特纳姆热刺队。与切尔西俱乐部一起提升您的比赛日 - 独家 VIP 体验现已发售。

news.title: Injury update: Emiliano Martinez
news.title_zh: 伤病更新：埃米利亚诺·马丁内斯
news.body_en: Chelsea Football Club has released the following update on Emiliano Martinez. Goalkeeper Emiliano Martinez has undergone successful surgery on a fractured jaw. Martinez was injured following a collision midway through the second half of our 2-0 victory over Everton at the Hill Dickinson Stadium on Saturday. Martinez was taken to hospital for further assessment, which confirmed a fractured jaw that required surgery. Everyone at Chelsea wishes Emi a speedy recovery and will support him throughout.
news.body_zh: 切尔西足球俱乐部发布了有关埃米利亚诺·马丁内斯的以下最新消息。守门员埃米利亚诺·马丁内斯的下巴骨折成功接受了手术。周六，我们在希尔迪金森体育场 2-0 战胜埃弗顿的比赛中，马丁内斯在下半场中段发生碰撞后受伤。马丁内斯被送往医院进行进一步评估，确认下巴骨折，需要手术。切尔西的每个人都祝愿埃米早日康复，并将自始至终支持他。

news.title: Alonso outlines Neto’s ‘great qualities’ and why Blues trio pleased him so much
news.title_zh: 阿隆索概述了内托的“伟大品质”以及为什么蓝军三人组如此令他满意
news.body_en: In what was, for long periods, a tight game at the Hill Dickinson Stadium, Pedro Neto’s two well-taken goals made the difference. For Xabi Alonso, it was yet another example of what the Portuguese offers this Chelsea team. With his pair of clinical left-footed finishes against Everton, Neto took his tally for the season to four goals. That figure is already almost half of the ten he notched in 2025/26. There is plenty more to Neto’s game than goals, though. Alonso has deployed him in a right-sided position so far this season. It is a role which allows him to showcase his attacking intent while continually contributing defensively, utilising his work rate and positional discipline. Click to shop the third kit now ‘You can call him whatever – winger, wing-back, attacker, defender – because he can do many things,’ said Alonso. ‘Pedro has great qualities. He’s always a threat, has a great competitive level, he can run, do one-v-ones, can score goals. ‘He’s so competitive. When he’s close to the action, he’s a threat against any full-back. When he’s on the last line or in between, he connects well with the players around, with Joao (Pedro), with Cole (Palmer), with Josh (Acheampong) as well. They worked really well, and I’m happy he could score.’ So far this season it has been the names of Palmer, Joao Pedro and Morgan Rogers that have stolen the headlines. While that trio did not score or assist on Saturday, Alonso was still delighted with their contributions. They led from the front and set the tone for a fantastic collective showing. ‘For me they played a fantastic game,’ he said. ‘They worked really hard. They were helping the team, Morgan on the wing, Cole and Joao in the middle. We need that to win as a team, so many positives from the game.’ Three points secured - now, the focus turns to our next huge clash at Stamford Bridge! news.title: Pedro Neto explains how Chelsea are implementing new Xabi Alonso ideas
news.title_zh: 佩德罗·内托解释了切尔西如何实施哈比·阿隆索的新想法
news.body_en: It’s now two impressive wins over two challenging Premier League opponents for Chelsea since the international break. And Blues winger Pedro Neto says that it is not by chance. The opening weeks of our campaign were entertaining, if not entirely convincing. Our attacking play was undeniably exciting and we scored plenty of goals, but Alonso's side were also conceding an average of two a game in the top flight. Alonso accepted that wasn't sustainable and emphasised the need for improvement ahead of the three-week international break, which gave him and the Chelsea coaching staff quality time to work with the players not away representing their countries. That practice was put into action against Bournemouth last weekend. The attacking adventure and invention remained, but the Blues were far more solid defensively, something aided by Moises Caicedo returning from injury and Jordan Henderson making his home debut. There was greater solidity to our display at Everton, with the Toffees, aside from two good first-half opportunities, restricted across the 90 minutes. It was notable that after establishing a lead through Pedro Neto's well-taken finish, the home side couldn't build momentum and genuinely threaten our goal. They ended with an expected goals total of 0.43. Neto credited a half-time tweak from Alonso to improve our build-up as an important factor in the victory, but also explained that the work done during the international break has been implemented in our past two matches. He said: 'I think during the international break, the manager had a little bit more time to focus on different ideas and try new things, and since we came back, he has been really vocal about that. 'We follow his ideas and we put effort into them, which is most important. And as you saw [against Everton] we had a really good game.' 'The ambition [for the rest of the season] is to take things game by game and then we will see what will happen. The important thing is that we approach every game like it’s the last one and that we continue to compete.'
news.body_zh: 自国际比赛日以来，切尔西已经战胜了两个具有挑战性的英超对手，取得了两场令人印象深刻的胜利。蓝军边锋佩德罗·内托表示这并非偶然。我们竞选活动的最初几周虽然不完全令人信服，但也很有趣。不可否认，我们的进攻非常令人兴奋，我们打进了很多球，但阿隆索的球队在顶级联赛中平均每场比赛丢了两个球。阿隆索承认这是不可持续的，并强调需要在为期三周的国际比赛日之前进行改进，这给了他和切尔西教练组与不代表自己国家出战的球员一起工作的优质时间。这种做法在上周末对阵伯恩茅斯的比赛中得到了体现。进攻的冒险和发明仍然存在，但蓝军的防守更加稳固，这得益于伤愈复出的莫伊塞斯·凯塞多和乔丹·亨德森的主场首秀。我们对阵埃弗顿的比赛表现得更加稳定，太妃糖队除了上半场两次不错的机会外，在整个 90 分钟内都受到了限制。值得注意的是，在通过佩德罗·内托的精彩射门确立领先优势后，主队无法建立势头并真正威胁我们的进球。他们最终的预期进球总数为 0.43。内托将阿隆索的半场调整归功于我们的胜利，这是我们取得胜利的一个重要因素，但他也解释说，国际比赛日期间所做的工作已经在我们过去的两场比赛中得到了落实。他说：“我认为在国际比赛日期间，主教练有更多的时间来关注不同的想法并尝试新事物，自从我们回来后，他一直在直言不讳地表达这一点。 “我们遵循他的想法，并为之付出努力，这是最重要的。正如你所看到的（对阵埃弗顿）我们踢了一场非常精彩的比赛。 “（本赛季剩余时间）的目标是一场场比赛地进行比赛，然后我们就会看看会发生什么。重要的是我们对待每一场比赛都像对待最后一场比赛一样，并且我们会继续竞争。”

news.title: Pedro Neto on the mentality and half-time tweak that downed Everton
news.title_zh: 佩德罗·内托谈击倒埃弗顿的心态和半场调整
news.body_en: Pedro Neto says the mentality of Chelsea's players to 'fight and win duels' against Everton, coupled with half-time tactical tweaks by manager Xabi Alonso, was crucial to the Blues recording a 2-0 win at the Hill Dickinson Stadium. A trip to the blue half of Merseyside is rarely easy. At Goodison Park, Everton supporters would create a hostile atmosphere that could suffocate visiting sides. The same can happen at their new stadium, as the Blues found out first-hand last term. It's why Alonso highlighted the importance of having the right mentality ahead of the game. The Chelsea manager's words were heeded. In a feisty opening 45 minutes, we stood up to the physical challenge posed by the Toffees. Strong challenges were not shirked. Loose balls were hotly contested. It gave the Blues a platform to build on, and in the second half, after Alonso altered how Chelsea built possession, we took control. Click to shop the third kit now Neto netted just 43 seconds after the restart, beating Jordan Pickford with a well-placed finish. We muted Everton's potential response, although at a cost as Emi Martinez was stretchered off after a heavy collision with Jarrad Branthwaite. The Blues handled the injury professionally, and in the 90th minute, Neto reacted quickest to a blocked Jordan Henderson free-kick and swept the ball home to seal our victory. 'Really hard three points playing away at this difficult stadium,' the Portugal international reflected after celebrating with the travelling Chelsea supporters. 'A word to our team-mate, who unfortunately got an injury, but we are really happy to get a win at this difficult stadium. 'They are a team that is very physical and have worked with the coach (David Moyes) for nearly two years – and he has really good ideas. They fight, they win duels and are really tough. But we came here with the same mentality and knew we had to run more than them and fight more than them.' Scoring early in halves has become a recurring theme of the Blues season, and Neto's opener was the latest example of Alonso's side catching another team off guard. Neto highlighted that, at the interval, the Chelsea manager and staff tweaked how the Blues would use the ball after spotting Everton pressing man-to-man in the opening period. It quickly paid off. 'We adjusted a little bit because we were seeing that they were pressing man-to-man on the goal kicks,' he explained. 'We won some duels in the first phase and got to the goal with an unbelievable play from Jorrel (Hato), then I got the ball to my feet and tried to finish. I’m happy I could do it.' Martinez's injury was the only disappointing note of the afternoon. Alonso confirmed after the game that the Argentinian was conscious when he left the stadium and was undergoing precautionary tests at a local hospital. The Blues goalkeeper certainly contributed to our victory with important saves in the first half. His replacement, Mike Penders, also kept Everton at bay as we recorded our first Premier League clean sheet of the campaign. Neto dedicated the shutout, and the victory, to Martinez. ‘This win is for him; he deserves it as he did a really good job. We hope he is okay and we are really happy to get the win for him. 'It’s a deserved clean sheet, and we've been waiting for a long time. He deserves it as well. He’s a great guy and I hope we continue like this to give him more.'
news.body_zh: 佩德罗·内托表示，切尔西球员在对阵埃弗顿的比赛中“战斗并获胜”的心态，加上主教练哈维·阿隆索的半场战术调整，对于蓝军在希尔迪金森体育场以 2-0 获胜至关重要。前往默西塞德郡的蓝半区旅行绝非易事。在古迪逊公园球场，埃弗顿的支持者会制造一种敌对的气氛，这可能会让客队窒息。同样的情况也可能发生在他们的新球场，蓝军在上个赛季就亲身体验到了这一点。这就是为什么阿隆索强调在比赛前保持正确心态的重要性。切尔西主帅的言论得到了重视。在激烈的开场 45 分钟里，我们顶住了太妃糖队带来的身体挑战。严峻的挑战没有被回避。松散球的争夺非常激烈。这为蓝军提供了一个继续发展的平台，在下半场，阿隆索改变了切尔西控球的方式后，我们控制了比赛。点击购买现在的第三套球衣 内托在比赛重新开始后仅 43 秒就攻入一球，以出色的进球击败了乔丹·皮克福德。我们压制了埃弗顿的潜在反应，尽管付出了代价，因为埃米·马丁内斯在与贾拉德·布兰斯韦特发生严重碰撞后被担架抬下。蓝军以专业的方式处理了伤病，第90分钟，内托对乔丹·亨德森的任意球反应最快，将球扫射破门，锁定了我们的胜利。这位葡萄牙国脚在与客场的切尔西球迷庆祝后说道，“在这个困难的球场上客场拿下三分真的很难。” “对我们的队友说几句话，他不幸受伤了，但我们真的很高兴能在这个艰难的球场取得一场胜利。 “他们是一支身体素质很强的球队，并且与教练（大卫·莫耶斯）合作了近两年，他的想法非常好。他们战斗，他们赢得决斗，而且非常强硬。但我们带着同样的心态来到这里，并且知道我们必须比他们跑得更多，比他们战斗得更多。”半场早期进球已经成为蓝军赛季反复出现的主题，内托的首开纪录是阿隆索的球队让另一支球队措手不及的最新例子。内托强调，在中场休息时，切尔西主帅和工作人员在发现埃弗顿在上半场进行人盯人逼抢后，调整了蓝军的控球方式。它很快得到了回报。 “我们进行了一些调整，因为我们看到他们在球门球上进行一对一的压迫，”他解释道。 “我们在第一阶段赢得了一些对决，并凭借乔雷尔（哈托）令人难以置信的表现取得了进球，然后我把球站起来并试图射门。我很高兴我能做到。马丁内斯的受伤是下午唯一令人失望的事情。阿隆索赛后证实，阿根廷人离开球场时意识清醒，正在当地一家医院接受预防性检查。蓝军门将在上半场做出了重要的扑救，为我们的胜利做出了贡献。他的继任者迈克·彭德斯也让埃弗顿陷入困境，我们创下了本赛季英超联赛的首个零失球。内托将这场绝杀和胜利献给了马丁内斯。 “这场胜利属于他；他应得的，因为他做得非常好。我们希望他没事，我们真的很高兴为他赢得胜利。 “这是一场当之无愧的零失球，我们已经等待很长时间了。他也是应得的。他是一个很棒的人，我希望我们继续这样，为他提供更多。”

news.title: Alonso issues Emiliano Martinez update
news.title_zh: 阿隆索发布埃米利亚诺·马丁内斯更新
news.body_en: Xabi Alonso has provided an update on Emiliano Martinez’s condition after the Chelsea goalkeeper was stretchered off during our 2-0 win at Everton. Martinez collided with two Toffees players when clearing a free-kick midway through the second half. After lengthy treatment, he was replaced by Mike Penders. ‘As far as I know, he left the stadium conscious and right now he is in the hospital doing precautionary tests,’ said Alonso. ‘So let’s see, but that’s what I know so far. We need to wait. Hopefully it won’t be too bad, but we need to wait at the moment.’ Alonso confirmed Malo Gusto missed today’s game through illness, while Pep Chavarria will undergo tests tomorrow (Sunday) to find out what the problem was he sustained in training on Friday. Martinez’s replacement, Penders, helped us see out the clean sheet, and Alonso explained his performance was indicative of players being able to step up when called upon. Alonso said: ‘Mike has personality, he’s brave, and we have full trust with him. He did well. He played in the cup games and whenever he’s needed, like the other players whenever they are needed they can perform. ‘It’s all about the squad, that all the players feel important and can have their moment whenever they are needed, and that’s very positive.’
news.body_zh: 切尔西门将埃米利亚诺·马丁内斯在我们 2-0 战胜埃弗顿的比赛中被担架抬下场后，哈维·阿隆索更新了埃米利亚诺·马丁内斯的伤情。下半场中段，马丁内斯解围任意球时与两名太妃糖球员相撞。经过长时间的治疗后，迈克·彭德斯接替了他的位置。阿隆索说，据我所知，他离开体育场时是意识清醒的，现在他正在医院进行预防性检查。 “所以让我们看看，但这就是我目前所知道的。我们需要等待。希望情况不会太糟糕，但我们现在需要等待。阿隆索证实马洛·古斯托因病缺席了今天的比赛，而佩普·查瓦里亚将于明天（周日）接受检查，以找出他在周五训练中遇到的问题。马丁内斯的替补彭德斯帮助我们完成了不失球，阿隆索解释说他的表现表明球员能够在需要时挺身而出。阿隆索说：“迈克有个性，他很勇敢，我们完全信任他。他做得很好。他参加了杯赛，只要需要他，就像其他球员一样，只要需要，他们就可以表现。 “这一切都与球队有关，所有球员都感到自己很重要，并且可以在需要的时候发挥自己的作用，这是非常积极的。”

news.title: Xabi Alonso reflects on a ‘serious, solid, very good’ away win
news.title_zh: 哈维·阿隆索回顾客场胜利“认真、扎实、非常好”
news.body_en: Xabi Alonso was delighted with the way his Chelsea team acquitted themselves at the Hill Dickinson Stadium, with a blend of defensive discipline, attacking cohesion and clinical finishing from Pedro Neto earning us three points and a first league clean sheet since January. Neto bagged a second-half brace to secure us a 2-0 victory against Everton, and the Blues matched Everton’s intensity, particularly in a tetchy opening 45 minutes when tempers flared. We took control of the contest right after the restart, though, and saw out the result with relative comfort, even adding a second late on to ensure there was no late drama during the 11 minutes added on following an injury to Emiliano Martinez. It was no surprise, then, that Alonso was so pleased afterwards. Click to shop the third kit now ‘We are very happy with the result and the performance,’ he said. ‘We needed one of these wins away, where we have played very professionally and seriously, looking solid. It was a very good win. We got many things right. ‘We looked in control of the game, there were moments for sure when we had to defend, especially in the first half, but overall the team looked mature, knew what to do in each moment, and knew we’d have our own moment. That happened in the second half. ‘After that, we were good with the ball, creating chances and not conceding much. To win away is always tough, and we got the clean sheet. We knew it was a matter of time and finally we got it.’ That clean sheet has been elusive, but it was thoroughly well earned. Martinez and his replacement Mike Penders stood tall when required, but in truth we restricted Everton to very few clear opportunities. And Alonso wants to use this shutout as a platform to build upon. ‘We need to keep working; it’s just one game,’ he pointed out. ‘One [clean sheet this season] would be very poor; we need to get many more clean sheets in the rest of the league games. 'The first of the season feels good, so we have to keep going in this way, working well and being serious, and knowing that wherever we go we can play in an efficient and professional way, as we did today.’ Three points secured - now, the focus turns to our next huge clash at Stamford Bridge! news.body_zh: 哈比·阿隆索对他的切尔西队在希尔迪金森体育场的表现感到高兴，他们结合了防守纪律、进攻凝聚力和佩德罗·内托的冷静射门，为我们赢得了三分，并自一月份以来首次在联赛中保持零失球。下半场内托梅开二度，帮助我们以 2-0 战胜埃弗顿，而蓝军的强度也与埃弗顿相当，尤其是在开场 45 分钟脾气暴躁的情况下。不过，我们在比赛重新开始后就控制了比赛，并相对轻松地看到了结果，甚至在最后时刻增加了一秒，以确保在埃米利亚诺·马丁内斯受伤后的 11 分钟内不会出现戏剧性的场面。因此，阿隆索事后如此高兴也就不足为奇了。点击立即购买第三套装备“我们对结果和表现非常满意，”他说。 “我们需要一场客场胜利，我们踢得非常专业和认真，看起来很稳定。这是一场非常好的胜利。我们做对了很多事情。 “我们看起来控制了比赛，肯定有一些时刻我们必须防守，尤其是在上半场，但总的来说，球队看起来很成熟，知道每个时刻该做什么，并且知道我们会有自己的时刻。那发生在下半场。 “在那之后，我们控球得很好，创造了机会，而且失球不多。客场取胜总是很艰难，但我们零失球。我们知道这只是时间问题，最终我们做到了。”这场零失球一直难以捉摸，但这是完全值得的。马丁内斯和他的继任者迈克·彭德斯在需要时挺身而出，但事实上我们限制了埃弗顿很少有明显的机会。阿隆索希望利用这次封锁作为进一步发展的平台。 “我们需要继续工作；这只是一场比赛，”他指出。 “如果（本赛季不失球）会非常糟糕；我们需要在剩下的联赛中获得更多的不失球。 “本赛季的第一个赛季感觉很好，所以我们必须继续以这种方式前进，做好工作并认真对待，并且知道无论我们走到哪里，我们都可以以高效和专业的方式踢球，就像我们今天所做的那样。”三分已经锁定——现在，焦点转向我们在斯坦福桥的下一场激烈冲突！为德比日做好准备，我们将迎战伦敦对手托特纳姆热刺队。与切尔西俱乐部一起提升您的比赛日 - 独家 VIP 体验现已发售。

news.title: Match report: Everton 0-2 Chelsea
news.title_zh: 比赛战报：埃弗顿 0-2 切尔西
news.body_en: Pedro Neto goals right at the start and end of the second half secured Chelsea a superb first win against Everton at the Hill Dickinson Stadium. The Blues battled hard in a fractious opening 45 minutes, matching Everton’s intensity and energy, just as Xabi Alonso had demanded pre-match. We might have opened the scoring through Moises Caicedo or Maxence Lacroix before Neto broke the deadlock just 43 seconds after the restart, tucking his finish away after fine work from Jorrel Hato down the left. The only disappointment on the day was what looked a nasty injury suffered by Emiliano Martinez, who was replaced by Mike Penders with plenty of the game remaining. We continued to stand tall in defence, though, and sealed the win when Neto swept home a loose ball from 12 yards out. As satisfying as three well-earned points on the road is a first clean sheet in the Premier League since January, no mean feat in a fixture in which shutouts and indeed wins have been hard to come by in recent years. Alonso made a solitary change to the side that defeated Bournemouth, with Hato coming in for Pep Chavarria on the left-hand side of defence after the Spaniard picked up a knock in training yesterday. There was to be no early goal for Chelsea as both sides scrapped hard in the opening stages. Much of the play was restricted to action in the middle third of the pitch. The first shot in anger arrived on 15 minutes from the left foot of Cole Palmer, 20 yards out, with Jordan Pickford equal to it. A sustained spell of Chelsea possession and territorial dominance culminated in our best chance yet after Neto got in down the right and cut the ball back to Jordan Henderson, whose shot was blocked before it could test Pickford. Martinez made his first save to deny Merlin Rohl but was then penalised for holding onto the ball too long. From the resulting corner, a second cross from Jack Grealish found an unmarked Thierno Barry, who headed straight at Martinez. With the half-hour mark approaching, Martinez was at full stretch to tip Grealish’s bouncing volley over. The ill-feeling continued. A coming-together inside our half resulted in cards shown to James Tarkowski and Morgan Rogers, taking the number of players booked up to five with just 34 minutes played. Our first corner of the game, with half-time approaching, almost yielded a spectacular opening goal. Henderson’s deep corner picked out Caicedo running round the back, and he couldn’t have met his volley any sweeter, displaying exemplary technique. Unfortunately, it rattled the crossbar rather than nestling in the net as the strike deserved. Before the half-time whistle brought an end to a hard-fought 45 minutes of football, Pickford made one more save, tipping Neto’s long-range shot over. From the flurry of Blues corners that followed, Lacroix saw his goalbound header hacked off the line by Harrison Armstrong. We may not have scored early in the first half, but we did in the second! A cute backheel from Rogers released the bombarding Hato, who strode beyond Ainsley Maitland-Niles. His centre missed Palmer but reached Neto, unmarked. He set himself and swept his finish under the outstretched arm of Pickford. Just 43 seconds had elapsed since the restart. We have now scored three goals in the opening minute of a half in the Premier League this season, already our joint-most in a single campaign, alongside 2011/12. Rogers had a shot well blocked by Rohl as we sought a quick second, and an impudent long-range chip from Palmer had Pickford worried but drifted over his crossbar. Midway through the second half, Martinez bravely cleared an inswinging free-kick and collided with Jarrad Branthwaite and Thierno Barry in the process. After lengthy treatment totalling ten minutes, our keeper was replaced by Penders, making his Premier League debut. The Belgian’s first contribution of note was a superb punch from just inside his box to clear a cross. We continued to defend resolutely, and almost hit the Toffees on the break with a second. Palmer had options left and right and opted to play in Joao Pedro, but Pickford stood tall to save. However, we did make the game safe just before the clock ticked over to 90. Henderson’s attempt at replicating his free-kick heroics from last weekend fell short, with the wall blocking his shot, but the loose ball fell kindly to Neto. He intelligently delayed shooting until the space was there to do so, and then rolled his strike into the opposite corner from where he had tucked away his first. The Chelsea supporters had been enjoying themselves throughout the second half in the Merseyside sunshine, and now they had extra cause for celebration as we negotiated 11 added minutes to earn a fine away victory. The Blues rise above Everton in the formative table ahead of the rest of this weekend's Premier League action. A big London derby at the Bridge is up next, with Tottenham visiting next Saturday 24 October for a 5.30pm kick-off. 的精彩射门后完成了射门。当天唯一令人失望的是埃米利亚诺·马丁内斯（Emiliano Martinez）遭受了严重的伤病，他在比赛还剩很长一段时间时被迈克·彭德斯（Mike Penders）换下。不过，我们在防守中继续保持高位，并在内托从 12 码外将球扫入球门时锁定了胜利。客场拿下三分，这是自一月份以来英超联赛首次零失球，这同样令人满意，这在近几年来很难实现零封和真正获胜的比赛中，绝非易事。阿隆索在击败伯恩茅斯的比赛中做了一个单独的换人，在西班牙人昨天训练中受伤后，哈托顶替了左后卫佩普·查瓦里亚。由于双方在开局阶段就打得很激烈，切尔西未能早早取得进球。比赛的大部分时间都限制在球场中三分之一的区域。第 15 分钟，科尔·帕尔默 (Cole Palmer) 在 20 码外左脚射门，乔丹·皮克福德 (Jordan Pickford) 追平了比分。内托从右路插上，将球切回给乔丹·亨德森，但亨德森的射门在考验皮克福德之前被挡出，切尔西持续的控球和领地优势最终为我们带来了最好的机会。马丁内斯第一次扑救扑出了梅林·罗尔，但随后因持球时间过长而受到处罚。从最后的角球中，杰克·格里利什的第二次传中找到了无人盯防的蒂尔诺·巴里，巴里直奔马丁内斯。随着半小时的临近，马丁内斯竭尽全力将格拉利什的弹射凌空击倒。不愉快的感觉还在继续。我们半场内的交锋导致詹姆斯·塔科夫斯基和摩根·罗杰斯出示了牌，使得在比赛仅进行了 34 分钟时，被黄牌警告的球员人数就达到了 5 人。比赛临近中场休息时，我们的第一个角球几乎就打进了一个精彩的开局进球。亨德森的深角球挑中了从后场跑过来的凯塞多，他的凌空抽射再漂亮不过了，展现出了堪称典范的技术。不幸的是，它击中了横梁，而不是像应有的那样入网。半场结束前，45分钟的激战结束，皮克福德再次做出扑救，将内托的远射挡出。从随后的蓝军角球中，拉克鲁瓦看到他的头球被哈里森·阿姆斯特朗砍出底线。上半场我们可能没有早点进球，但下半场我们进球了！罗杰斯漂亮的后脚跟释放了轰击的哈托，哈托大步超越了安斯利·梅特兰·奈尔斯。他的中锋错过了帕尔默，但在无人盯防的情况下传到了内托。他站稳了脚跟，在皮克福德伸出的手臂下完成了射门。距离重启仅过了43秒。本赛季我们在英超联赛中在半场开场一分钟就打进了三个进球，与 2011/12 赛季并列单赛季进球数最多的球队。当我们寻求快速第二球时，罗杰斯的一脚射门被罗尔挡出，帕尔默的一脚无礼的远射让皮克福德担心，但飘过了横梁。下半场中段，马丁内斯勇敢解围内旋任意球，并在此过程中与贾拉德·布兰斯维特和蒂尔诺·巴里相撞。经过长达十分钟的漫长治疗后，我们的门将被彭德斯换下，这是他的英超首秀。比利时人的第一个值得注意的贡献是在禁区内的一记精彩的拳击，将球解围。我们继续坚决防守，差点在第二次破门时击中太妃糖。帕尔默左右都有选择，他选择了若奥·佩德罗上场，但皮克福德挺身而出，进行了扑救。然而，就在比赛即将结束时，我们确实让比赛安全了。亨德森试图复制上周末的任意球英雄风格，但没有成功，人墙挡住了他的射门，但松散的球落在了内托手中。 news.title: Under-18 Premier League report: West Bromwich Albion 3-5 Chelsea
news.title_zh: 18岁以下英超联赛报告：西布罗姆维奇3-5切尔西
news.body_en: Chelsea moved to the top of the Under-18 Premier League South table after braces from Heze Grimwade and Jacob Dako, and a goal from Andrew Pennie, helped the Blues claim a 5-3 away win at West Bromwich Albion. Goals from Grimwade and Dako in the opening 20 minutes put us in control, and Grimwade added his second before the interval. However, a double from West Brom captain Harry French kept the hosts firmly in the contest. In the second period, Dako completed his brace and Pennie made sure the three points would be coming back to Cobham when he netted in the 70th minute. West Brom did grab a third late on as French completed his hat-trick, but it proved only a small consolation for the hosts. The Blues set the pace immediately in the West Midlands, moving the ball through the thirds well. We thought we had broken the deadlock just a few minutes into the game when Pennie found the net, but his goal was ruled out for offside. It didn’t take long for the young Blues to go in front, though. In the 16th minute, Grimwade orchestrated an attack that saw him exchange passes with Isaac McGillvary and fired a finish into the bottom right corner from the edge of the penalty area. Dako doubled our advantage three minutes later from a free kick won by Pennie: his long-range attempt was helped on its way via a big deflection to put Chelsea in the driving seat. However, on the half-hour mark, West Brom halved the deficit from the penalty spot through French. There was still much work to do to ensure victory. Grimwade put the Blues back in control before the break, with an inswinging corner that ended in the the back of the net at the near post. Unfortunately, French pulled a second goal back for the hosts moments before the half-time whistle was sounded. The Blues started the second period well and, six minutes after the restart, we re-established a two-goal advantage for the third time in the contest. Dako showed excellent attacking instincts to react quickest to a loose ball after Eden Perez’s strike was blocked, and he took a touch and rifled a finish beyond goalkeeper Maxwell Moses from 20 yards. Pennie came close to making it five when he went through on goal, but his shot took a small nick and went out for a corner. The Blues had a lot more success in the third final when we were patient in possession. The Blues fashioned another chance after we moved the ball from side-to-side for a prolonged spell before substitute Ibrahim Rabbaj was found on the edge of the box. Rabbaj’s first touch took him onto his right foot, but his shot went just wide of the far post. With 20 minutes remaining, Pennie finally got his goal after showing excellent composure when one-on-one with the goalkeeper. The ball came over the top and through to the Blues forward, who drove towards goal from inside his own half with purpose before dispatching a finessed shot into the far corner. The goal was Pennie's ninth across all competitions for the Under-18s this season. French completed his hat-trick for the hosts late on, but it was too little too late as Chelsea returned back to Cobham with all three points. Victory for the Blues sends them the top of the Under-18 Premier League on 18 points. We have won our last four matches on the bounce in the competition and six of our eight matches total. Chelsea Under-18s are back at Cobham on Saturday 24 October, when we face Ipswich in the Under-18 Premier League. The game gets underway at 12pm and supporters can watch the live match with a CFC+ subscription. news.body_zh: 赫泽·格里姆韦德和雅各布·达科的梅开二度以及安德鲁·彭尼的进球帮助蓝军客场 5-3 战胜西布罗姆维奇，切尔西在 18 岁以下英超南区积分榜上排名第一。格里姆韦德和达科在开场 20 分钟的进球让我们控制了局势，格里姆韦德在中场休息前打进了他的第二个进球。然而，西布朗队队长哈里·弗伦奇的梅开二度让主队稳稳地保住了比赛。第二节，达科完成梅开二度，佩尼在第70分钟进球，确保科巴姆将三分回归。随着弗兰奇完成帽子戏法，西布朗队确实在最后时刻获得了第三个进球，但这对主队来说只是一个小小的安慰。蓝军立即在西米德兰兹确立了节奏，将球顺利地传过第三区。比赛开始几分钟后，当佩尼破门时，我们以为我们已经打破了僵局，但他的进球因越位而被判无效。不过，没过多久，年轻的蓝军就领先了。第16分钟，格里姆韦德发起进攻，与麦吉尔瓦里接球，禁区边缘射门入球右下角。三分钟后，佩尼赢得任意球，达科将我们的优势扩大了一倍：他的远射通过一个大偏转帮助切尔西取得了领先地位。然而，在半小时后，西布朗队通过法国点球将比分差距缩小了一半。为了确保胜利，还有很多工作要做。格里姆韦德在中场休息前帮助蓝军重新掌控局面，他的内旋角球在近门柱处射入球网。不幸的是，在半场哨声响起前，法国队为主队扳回第二球。蓝军第二节开局不错，比赛重新开始六分钟后，我们在比赛中第三次重新建立了两球优势。在伊登·佩雷斯的射门被挡出后，达科表现出了出色的进攻本能，对松散的球做出了最快的反应，他在 20 码处触球，越过了门将麦克斯韦尔·摩西的射门。当佩尼射门时，他差点打进五球，但他的射门出现了一个小缺口，并被罚出角球。当我们控球时保持耐心时，蓝军在第三场决赛中取得了更大的成功。在我们将球从一边转移到另一边很长时间之后，蓝军创造了另一次机会，直到替补球员易卜拉欣·拉巴伊在禁区边缘被发现。拉巴伊第一次触球就用右脚，但他的射门稍稍偏出远门柱。比赛还剩20分钟时，佩尼在与门将一对一时表现出出色的冷静，终于取得了进球。球从球顶飞过，传到了蓝军前锋手中，后者从本方半场内有目的地射向球门，然后巧妙地将球射入远角。这是彭尼本赛季在 18 岁以下青年队所有比赛中打进的第九个进球。弗兰奇在最后时刻为东道主完成了帽子戏法，但为时已晚，切尔西全取三分回到科巴姆。蓝军的胜利让他们积 18 分位列 18 岁以下英超联赛榜首。我们在比赛中赢得了过去四场比赛的胜利，总共八场比赛中的六场。切尔西 U-18 队将于 10 月 24 日星期六回到科巴姆，届时我们将在 U-18 英超联赛中对阵伊普斯维奇。比赛将于中午 12 点开始，支持者可以通过 CFC+ 订阅观看现场比赛。切尔西（4-3-3）：托比·贝尔；莱利·埃博 (加布里埃尔·桑布 62’)、丹特·维特 (中)、雅各布·霍尔、卡尔文·迪亚基特 (伊萨戈·席尔瓦 80’)；艾萨克·巴杜、雅各布·达科（Kwamina Ampah 80’）、艾萨克·麦吉尔瓦里； Heze Grimwade (Ibrahim Rabbaj 62’), Andrew Pennie (Jayden Malundama 82’), Eden Perez未上场替补：Antoni Miernik得分者：Grimwade 16, 45+2, Dako 19, 51, Pennie 70黄牌：Pennie 64’ 西布罗姆维奇：马克斯韦尔·摩西；泰瑞尔·哈钦森、迪伦·纳西布、肖恩·冈佩、乔尔·阿索莫加；西奥·杰克逊 (鲁本·萨 62’)、奥马尔·桑科 (丹亚尔·伊克巴尔 67’)、哈里·弗伦奇 (中锋)、雷马尔·麦克尼尔 (弗雷泽·比林斯 67’)、科尔·德克斯特 (伊森·史密斯 60’)、贾斯汀·七七 (詹姆斯·拜瑟尔 60’) 未上场替补：贾戈·戴维斯、阿奇·威廉姆斯得分：法国 31、45+4、 86黄牌：杰克逊 17’

news.title: Alonso on his alteration for Everton and midfield duo
news.title_zh: 阿隆索谈他对埃弗顿和中场组合的改变
news.body_en: Xabi Alonso wants Chelsea to ‘repeat the right things’ against Everton this afternoon – and has explained the one change made to the Blues side. After a 5-1 victory against Bournemouth last time out, we have travelled to Merseyside for what is our first fixture outside of London this season. Everton are unbeaten in the top flight this term and are never an easy proposition to face on home soil. Yet Alonso has challenged his side to show the same qualities that enabled us to impressively overcome the Cherries. ‘We needed a win [last weekend] and now we need to keep going, repeat the right things, and always improve game by game.’ The one alteration to the starting XI is Jorrel Hato’s introduction for Pep Chavarria. It was an enforced switch. ‘[Pep had] a little problem yesterday; we are not certain of the situation yet because it was late. Jorrel is fit and has played there, so it’s just that change.’ Alonso’s selection sees Moises Caicedo, who wears the captain’s armband, line up in midfield once again by Jordan Henderson, who netted twice against Bournemouth. It's a partnership Alonso believes provides the Blues with several different qualities. He said: ‘We have enough options in midfield, with Romeo (Lavia), (Valentin) Barco – they have played this season – and now we have Moi and Hendo back. ‘It was a good first day with them playing together in the middle; they gave balance, personality and stability to the rest of the team. 'They mix very well in terms of qualities and personalities, so that’s very important for any team. They did really well and today we’ll need another big one in this stadium, against a tough opponent.’
news.body_zh: 哈维·阿隆索希望切尔西今天下午对阵埃弗顿时能够“重复正确的事情”，并解释了蓝军方面所做的一项改变。继上次以 5-1 战胜伯恩茅斯后，我们前往默西塞德郡参加本赛季伦敦以外的第一场比赛。埃弗顿本赛季在顶级联赛中保持不败，在主场面对对手从来都不是一件容易的事。然而，阿隆索向他的球队提出了挑战，要求他们展现出让我们令人印象深刻地战胜樱桃队的同样品质。 “我们需要一场胜利（上周末），现在我们需要继续前进，重复正确的事情，并始终在一场一场地提高。”首发阵容的一个变化是乔雷尔·哈托（Jorrel Hato）对佩普·查瓦里亚（Pep Chavarria）的介绍。这是一个强制转换。 “[佩普]昨天遇到了一点问题；我们还不确定情况，因为已经晚了。乔雷尔身体健康，并且在那里踢过球，所以这就是一个变化。”阿隆索的选择是戴上队长袖标的莫伊塞斯·凯塞多，与对阵伯恩茅斯的比赛中梅开二度的乔丹·亨德森再次出现在中场。阿隆索相信这种合作关系为蓝军提供了多种不同的品质。他说：“我们在中场有足够的选择，罗密欧（拉维亚）、（瓦伦丁）巴科——他们本赛季都踢过球——现在我们有莫伊和亨多回来了。” “第一天他们在中场一起踢球，这是美好的一天；他们为团队的其他成员带来了平衡、个性和稳定性。 “他们在品质和个性方面融合得很好，所以这对任何球队来说都非常重要。他们表现得非常好，今天我们需要在这个体育场里对阵一个强硬的对手，再打一场大比赛。”

news.title: Confirmed Chelsea line up vs Everton
news.title_zh: 确认切尔西对阵埃弗顿的阵容
news.body_en: Xabi Alonso has made one change to his Chelsea starting XI for our Premier League fixture away to Everton. Jorrel Hato comes in on the left of defence with Pep Chavarria not in today’s matchday squad after picking up a knock in training on Friday. Other than that, Alonso keeps faith with the side that defeated Bournemouth 5-1 last weekend. Jordan Henderson, who scored twice in that game, partners Moises Caicedo in central midfield once more. Caicedo is wearing the captain’s armband today. Cole Palmer, Morgan Rogers and Joao Pedro will look to continue their fine form, with the Brazilian starting his 50th game for the Blues, who will be wearing our third kit for the first time. The bench includes 16-year-old Mahdi Nicoll-Jazuli, who made his Chelsea debut in our last away game at Brentford. Former Blue Kiernan Dewsbury-Hall starts for our hosts, while Tyrique George is named among the substitutes.
