news.title: Alonso on Caicedo and Henderson partnership, Lavia momentum and ‘warrior’ Barco
news.title_zh: 阿隆索谈凯塞多和亨德森的合作关系、拉维亚的势头和“战士”巴可
news.body_en: Xabi Alonso is confident in the midfield options available against Everton, highlighting the burgeoning partnership between Moises Caicedo and Jordan Henderson, as well as the early-season form of Romeo Lavia and Valentin Barco. The Blues will be without Reece James for today’s Premier League fixture at the Hill Dickinson Stadium, with our captain recovering from successful minor knee surgery. Yet Alonso has reiterated that we remain well stocked in midfield. That was demonstrated by the instant understanding between Caicedo and Henderson in our last game, an emphatic 5-1 victory over Bournemouth, which was the latter's home debut. The Blues manager believes those two players complement each other’s strengths well as a midfield pairing, even while pointing out that different situations call for different solutions in that area of the pitch. ‘It was only one game, but I think that Moi helps Hendo and Hendo helps Moi,’ said Alonso. ‘In terms of personalities, they match well, Moi and Hendo. ‘As well, Hendo has this energy to go; he's very active. He covers a lot of pitch and finds the balance with Moi, who’s more in the position and has this stability to have good distances with everything. It was a good start and we need to keep building from that. ‘But we need not just two midfielders; we need more than that. Sometimes we will need a third midfielder as well. It's not that we always play with just two midfielders. ‘There will be games or moments that we will need a third midfielder as well, to have a different approach or different analysis of the game. So we can't just rely on two midfielders. We need more than that.’ There is no concern from Alonso over that fact. Having been impressed with the performances of Lavia and Barco so far this season, our manager is confident in the other options at his disposal. ‘I've said good things about Rom because he's in a good moment,’ Xabi continued. ‘As well, Valentin against Brentford, even if the game didn't go right, it was his first [Premier League] start and he was very competitive. ‘In the minutes Valentin has played with us, also in the cup, he has been very competitive. He doesn't care who the opponent is – he goes, he goes, he goes. That's a little bit of this warrior fighting spirit that he brings to the team. It is very positive as well. ‘Obviously, it's been difficult for Rom - the record he had, he was not available for a few periods - but until now he's done really well since I’ve been here. He's been available. He's played a lot of games. So it's very good for him, especially that he's been able to be training regularly, playing regularly, playing 90 minutes. ‘So it's been great and he's in a very good momentum, and we need him with the other midfielders because that area is fundamental for our game.’ Of course, few people are as well placed to judge what it takes to succeed as a Premier League midfielder as Alonso, who achieved legendary status in that position during his own playing career with Real Sociedad, Liverpool, Real Madrid, Bayern Munich and Spain. With that in mind, he explained what is key for whoever gets the nod in the Chelsea midfield, and why those roles are vital to the team as a whole. ‘The midfielders, they need to take, for me, in a game many, many, many decisions. Small ones that they look meaningless, but they are very significant. ‘So that means that they are always thinking one step ahead of the game, and I think that Moi, Hendo, Rom, Barco, we are working for that. And when that works, normally the team works better. ‘We did really well the other day with Hendo and with Moi, and that they choose the right decision, because normally when they do things well, they help the team around, because they are in the middle of everything. 'You need to be enjoying that responsibility that you have there in the middle.’
news.body_zh: 哈维·阿隆索对对阵埃弗顿的中场选择充满信心，强调了莫伊塞斯·凯塞多和乔丹·亨德森之间迅速发展的合作关系，以及罗密欧·拉维亚和瓦伦丁·巴科的赛季初状态。蓝军将缺席今天在希尔迪金森体育场举行的英超比赛，里斯·詹姆斯将缺席，我们的队长从成功的膝盖小手术中恢复过来。然而阿隆索重申，我们的中场阵容仍然充足。凯塞多和亨德森在上一场比赛中的默契就证明了这一点，我们以 5-1 的比分大胜伯恩茅斯，这是后者的主场首秀。蓝军主教练相信这两名球员可以互补对方的优势以及中场组合，尽管他也指出不同的情况需要在球场的那个区域采取不同的解决方案。 “这只是一场比赛，但我认为莫伊帮助了亨多，亨多也帮助了莫伊，”阿隆索说。 “就性格而言，莫伊和亨多很匹配。 “同样，Hendo 也有这样的能量；他非常活跃。他覆盖了很多球场并找到了与莫伊的平衡，莫伊的位置更佳，并且具有稳定性，可以与一切保持良好的距离。这是一个良好的开端，我们需要以此为基础继续努力。 “但我们不仅需要两名中场球员，还需要两名中场球员。”我们需要的还不止这些。有时我们还需要第三名中场球员。我们并不总是只用两名中场球员进行比赛。 “在某些比赛或时刻，我们也需要第三名中场球员，以便对比赛有不同的方法或不同的分析。所以我们不能仅仅依靠两名中场球员。我们需要的不仅仅是这些。”阿隆索对此并不担心。本赛季到目前为止，拉维亚和巴科的表现给我们留下了深刻的印象，我们的主教练对他可以使用的其他选择充满信心。 “我对罗姆说了好话，因为他现在正处于一个很好的时刻，”哈比继续说道。 “还有，瓦伦丁对阵布伦特福德，即使比赛进展不顺利，这也是他第一次在英超联赛中首发，他非常有竞争力。 “瓦伦丁和我们一起踢球的时间里，包括杯赛上，他都非常有竞争力。他不在乎对手是谁——他走，他走，他走。这就是他给球队带来的一点战士战斗精神。这也是非常积极的。 “显然，这对罗姆来说很困难——按照他的记录，他有好几次都无法上场——但自从我来到这里以来，直到现在他都表现得很好。”他有空。他打过很多比赛。所以这对他来说非常好，特别是他能够定期训练，定期比赛，打满 90 分钟。 “所以这很棒，他的势头非常好，我们需要他和其他中场球员一起，因为这个区域对我们的比赛至关重要。”当然，很少有人像阿隆索那样能够很好地判断如何才能成为一名成功的英超中场球员，他在皇家社会、利物浦、皇家马德里、拜仁慕尼黑和西班牙的职业生涯中在这个位置上取得了传奇般的地位。考虑到这一点，他解释了对于切尔西中场来说什​​么是关键，以及为什么这些角色对整个球队至关重要。 “对于我来说，中场球员需要在一场比赛中做出很多很多的决定。看似无意义的小事，却意义重大。 “所以这意味着他们总是在比赛中领先一步，我认为 Moi、Hendo、Rom、Barco，我们正在为此努力。当这种方法奏效时，团队通常会工作得更好。 “前几天我们在亨多和莫伊身上表现得非常好，他们做出了正确的决定，因为通常当他们做得很好时，他们会帮助球队，因为他们处于一切的中间。 “你需要享受中间的责任。”

news.title: Maika Hamano outlines her 'big dream' ahead of facing former side Tottenham
news.title_zh: 滨野舞香在面对前东家托特纳姆热刺队之前概述了她的“伟大梦想”
news.body_en: Maika Hamano is not well known for scoring with her head, but that’s how the Blues forward netted our third goal against West Ham United before the international break. She then went on to represent Japan, scoring again against Haiti in a 5-1 friendly win less than a week later. It really didn’t matter how she scored her first goal of the season for the Blues, but as she explained when we sat down with her ahead of Sunday’s match against Tottenham Hotspur at Stamford Bridge, the timing of her strike was crucial. ‘It felt like relief,’ she says. ‘And I was proud of myself and thankful to my teammates. For me, the most important thing was doing something goal-related, like when you score or assist. I have been waiting all season to do it. ‘It’s been difficult at times, but I think now I have a rhythm, and as a footballer, everyone needs to prepare for their chances. If you have a chance, you need to take it.’ Hamano spent the second half of last season on loan at Tottenham, and Sunday’s game will see her face her former team-mates for the first time. ‘When I was at Tottenham, I learned a lot about tactics from (head coach) Martin Ho,’ Hamano reflects. ‘I learned from my team-mates as well; they play well as a team together. ‘They will be difficult to play against on Sunday because they have confidence on the ball and they play with patience – they don’t rush to get to the goal. ‘We will have difficult moments, but we need to deal with them. We need to play like Chelsea. When we have the ball, we need to be strong and to be ourselves, like champions. We can control the game. We need to be patient and take our chances when they come.’ Still just 22 years old, Hamano wants to keep striving for excellence and set high standards for herself. Our conversation turns towards what she wants to achieve in football, and she is unequivocal in her answer. ‘I have a big dream, so I need to make each day count, and I need to improve,’ she smiles. ‘I know I'm a good player, but I'm not like (Lionel) Messi - I still have room to improve. ‘My big dream is to win the Ballon d'Or and win the World Cup with Japan. I want to improve day by day and always be the best version of myself. 'For me, football is life and football is everything. So I will do whatever it takes to succeed.’
news.body_zh: 滨野舞香并不以用头得分而闻名，但这就是这位蓝军前锋在国际比赛日之前对阵西汉姆联队的比赛中攻入第三个进球的方式。随后，她代表日本队出战，不到一周后，在友谊赛中以 5-1 战胜海地队的比赛中，她再次进球。她如何为蓝军打进本赛季的第一个进球并不重要，但正如她在周日斯坦福桥对阵托特纳姆热刺队的比赛前与我们坐下来交谈时所解释的那样，她的进球时机至关重要。 “这感觉像是一种解脱，”她说。 “我为自己感到自豪，并感谢我的队友。对我来说，最重要的是做一些与目标相关的事情，比如当你得分或助攻时。我整个赛季都在等待这样做。 “有时这很困难，但我认为现在我有了节奏，作为一名足球运动员，每个人都需要为自己的机会做好准备。如果你有机会，你需要抓住它。”滨野上赛季后半段被租借到托特纳姆热刺队，周日的比赛将是她第一次面对她的前队友。 “当我在托特纳姆热刺时，我从（主教练）何马丁那里学到了很多战术知识，”滨野回忆道。 “我也向我的队友们学习；他们作为一个团队一起踢得很好。 “周日他们会很难对付，因为他们对球有信心，而且踢球很有耐心——他们不会急于进球。 “我们会遇到困难的时刻，但我们需要应对它们。我们需要像切尔西一样踢球。当我们控球时，我们需要变得坚强，做我们自己，就像冠军一样。我们可以控制比赛。我们需要保持耐心，并在机会来临时抓住机会。” 年仅 22 岁的 Hamano 希望继续追求卓越，为自己设定高标准。我们的谈话转向她想在足球中实现什么，她的回答也很明确。 “我有一个伟大的梦想，所以我需要让每一天都有意义，我需要进步，”她微笑着说。 “我知道我是一名优秀的球员，但我不像（莱昂内尔）梅西——我仍然有进步的空间。 “我最大的梦想是赢得金球奖并与日本队一起赢得世界杯。我想一天天进步，永远成为最好的自己。 “对我来说，足球就是生活，足球就是一切。所以我会尽一切努力去取得成功。”

news.title: From the archive: Graeme Le Saux reflects on his two-part Chelsea career
news.title_zh: 来自档案馆：格雷姆·勒索克斯回顾他的两段切尔西生涯
news.body_en: To mark Graeme Le Saux’s 58th birthday, we bring an interview he conducted in 2006 back to the surface, in which he dissects his time at Chelsea which spanned two spells and nearly two decades… When Graeme Le Saux returned to Stamford Bridge from Blackburn Rovers in 1997, the fee was impressive for a full-back, especially one that the club had sold four years earlier. But, in the words of then managing director Colin Hutchinson: ‘Selling him was a mistake which took £5 million to rectify.’ Any supporter forced to leave Chelsea behind in 1993 only to return four years down the line would have been dazzled by the near-wholesale transformation of the club in those years. Familiar faces would have been few and far between in the starting line-up, the stadium almost unrecognisable and a new continental flair added to the team’s playing style. Imagine that and you would be somewhere close to realising the emotions and the changes experienced by Graeme Le Saux in 1997. At that time, the England left-back was at his peak and he wanted to demonstrate that to the supporters who had seen him as a raw talent in the late Eighties and early Nineties. ‘I was offered the opportunity to come back to Chelsea, which was a big decision for me, going back where I had a sort of chequered history,’ he says of the move. ‘Paying that much for someone they sold four years earlier takes a lot of bravery from a club, and it meant a huge amount to me as it showed how much they wanted me.’ It wasn’t just Graeme who had improved since his departure. The club had grown in stature with the arrival of the likes of Glenn Hoddle, Mark Hughes and, of course, Ruud Gullit. And it was the former who began to attract the even bigger names that Chelsea supporters became accustomed to during that period. ‘Compared with my previous spell at the club, the atmosphere was completely different,’ he says. ‘It was incredibly positive and the standard of football was much better. There were some great influences. ‘In fact, going through that team, there was a character in each position, from Frank Leboeuf and Marcel Desailly in defence, through to Gus Poyet, Robbie Di Matteo and Dennis Wise in midfield and Franco Zola up front with Hughesy.’ It was a very different Chelsea side Le Saux joined when he came over from Jersey in 1987. Before the European superstars had arrived with their unique characters off the pitch and their world-class quality on it, there was another Chelsea that Graeme found it tough to fit into. ‘It was quite a hostile environment really,’ he recalls. ‘The club was going through a difficult spell and John Hollins got the sack not long after I joined – it was a tough place to be at that time. You had to have a strong character to survive in that sort of atmosphere. ‘Because the club got relegated, everybody was looking out for themselves and certain groups of players became dominant, so it was very political. And for a young player trying to develop it was always going to be hard.’ But it wasn’t all doom and gloom for the young Le Saux, who had been recommended to Hollins while he was in Jersey to present the island’s player of the year award. Arguably, the club’s best talent upon his arrival was left-back Tony Dorigo, which offered him the ideal opportunity to hone his own skills and learn from an international footballer. ‘Tony forced himself into the England squad and from my perspective I had no chance of getting into the side, and cover was Clive Wilson who was another excellent player. They were two really good guys, but I just kept my head down and did my best in the reserves. ‘You learn a lot from all the people around you and although it was a tough environment, there were some very good influences there as well. I was not only learning about football, but also about living in London and discovering myself away from home. I had come from a small island and was finding out what London had to offer. It was a fairly unstable time, but equally very exciting on the field. ‘My first big game memory is when we played Spurs at Stamford Bridge and I played against Terry Fenwick, who had been playing for England. I had a really good game and did everything but score. People who remember that game still say that it was one of my best – that was when I came onto the scene and made an impression.’ Once he eventually broke into the team in the 1990/91 season, Le Saux often played on the left side of midfield and he struggled to make the position his own. ‘I didn’t have one position that a manager could say: “Right, that’s where you play,” and that added to the inconsistency,’ he remembers. ‘But it was something that helped me develop as a footballer because eventually I became known as an attacking full-back with Blackburn and, subsequently, England, where I played in different systems as a left-back, wing-back and on the left of midfield.’ That versatility didn’t impress David Webb when he took over as manager at Stamford Bridge in 1993. The former defensive stalwart arrived at the club with fresh ideas, ideas that Le Saux was not a part of. The promising left-back was sold to Blackburn almost immediately after Webb had taken the reins at Chelsea and he departed determined to prove a point to the man who so quickly discarded him. ‘Webb was my fourth manager at Chelsea in six years, which shows how unsettled the club was,’ Le Saux points out. ‘He took over, saw me play for half a game and decided I was rubbish. He basically said that he didn’t think I had a future. I proved him wrong ,didn’t I!’ Le Saux soon found himself in the international fold after his move to Blackburn. By the 1994/95 season, he had slotted straight into Kenny Dalglish’s newly assembled squad and earned a place in Terry Venables’ England team. Now at the beginning of his prime, Le Saux became a Premiership champion with Rovers in 1995 and was viewed as the country’s best full-back by many in the game. But the atmosphere at Blackburn soon soured as Dalglish moved on and the leadership of that team was lost somewhat. Elsewhere, a new era was on the horizon at his former West London stamping ground as the arrival of Hoddle and Gullit heralded the new continental Chelsea who would compete for honours in the near future. And following Gullit’s ascendancy into management, the board offered him funds to improve Chelsea’s FA Cup-winning squad further. Only the best would suffice, and with Scott Minto moving on, there was a vacancy at left-back. In August 1997, he returned to the side of characters he so vividly described, and he was happy working under Gullit. But, as was the case with Hollins in 1987, the boss parted company with Chelsea not long after Le Saux had signed. ‘I’ve seen off a few managers in my time,’ he joked. ‘Ruud got sacked and Luca took over and we were successful under him, but with Ruud’s team. It upset the balance of the club a bit and the direction, because if you look at the best clubs, they have consistency in their management and I just think it gives players an understanding with the manager.’ Fortunately, though, Gianluca Vialli was able to take over with relatively little upheaval, having been a player at the club under Gullit. The Italian won five trophies in his time as manager, although Le Saux has memories of missed opportunities. ‘I didn’t play in the Cup Winners’ Cup final because I had a calf injury three or four weeks before,’ he says. ‘I was out there with them and I played in every game leading up to the final, so I won the Cup Winners’ Cup, if you like. ‘The semi-final tie with Vicenza at the Bridge was special and the atmosphere was fantastic. That place rocked when the supporters were up for the game, and the Chelsea fans were so noisy away from home, they always impressed me. 'And when it got going at Stamford Bridge it was brilliant – there was normally a really positive atmosphere and the supporters understood that we were doing the best we could and we had a very good record at home during those years.’ There was more frustration to come when he missed the successful FA Cup final in 2000. ‘I had missed most of that season after breaking my ankle up at Blackburn,’ he recalls. ‘I had two operations on my ankle and it took nine or ten months to recover from. ‘So it was a terrible personal year for me because we’d started well, and played some fantastic games in the Champions League, most notably against Galatasaray in Turkey when we beat them 5-0. They went on to win the UEFA Cup unbeaten that season, so it shows what a great achievement that was.’ Once Vialli moved on following a poor start to the 2000/01 campaign, a new era was ushered in and things began to come to an end for that much-loved Blues generation. ‘Claudio Ranieri took over and that’s when we really lost our momentum because he broke the team up,’ Le Saux remembered. ‘There were probably players that he had to move on as part of the transition of bringing in younger players, but he did it in a way that disrupted the momentum that we’d got going so we were unable to win anything with him.’ The old order went out one door – in the shape of Wise, Poyet and Leboeuf – while in came a host of signings with a mixed success rate. Le Saux remained, though, and was still here as we returned to the Champions League with a dramatic victory over Liverpool on the final day in 2002/03 – it also proved to be his last game for Chelsea. For the fresh-faced islander who arrived 16 years earlier, it was a fitting finale to a wonderful Blues career. - A version of this article was first published in 2006
news.body_zh: 为了纪念格雷姆·勒索克斯的 58 岁生日，我们将他在 2006 年进行的一次采访带回到表面，其中他剖析了他在切尔西的时光，跨越了两个时期，近二十年……当格雷姆·勒索克斯于 1997 年从布莱克本流浪者队回到斯坦福桥时，对于一名边后卫来说，转会费是令人印象深刻的，尤其是俱乐部四年前出售的边后卫。但是，用时任总经理科林·哈钦森的话来说：“卖掉他是一个错误，需要花费 500 万英镑才能纠正。”任何在 1993 年被迫离开切尔西、四年后又回归的球迷都会对俱乐部在那些年里近乎大规模的转型感到眼花缭乱。首发阵容中熟悉的面孔很少见，球场几乎认不出来，而球队的比赛风格也增添了新的大陆风格。想象一下，你会接近意识到格雷姆·勒索克斯在 1997 年所经历的情感和变化。当时，这位英格兰左后卫正处于巅峰期，他想向那些在八十年代末和九十年代初将他视为天才的支持者证明这一点。 “我得到了回到切尔西的机会，这对我来说是一个重大决定，回到了我曾经有过一段曲折历史的地方，”他谈到这次转会时说道。 “为四年前卖掉的人支付如此高的价格需要俱乐部很大的勇气，这对我来说意义重大，因为这表明他们有多么想要我。”自从格雷姆离开后，进步的不仅仅是格雷姆。随着格伦·霍德尔、马克·休斯，当然还有路德·古利特等人的到来，俱乐部的地位不断提高。正是前者开始吸引切尔西球迷在那段时期已经习惯的更大牌的球员。 “与我之前在俱乐部的时光相比，这里的气氛完全不同，”他说。 “这是非常积极的事情，足球的水平也提高了很多。有一些很大的影响。 “事实上，纵观这支球队，每个位置都有一个角色，从后防线的弗兰克·勒伯夫和马塞尔·德塞利，到中场的格斯·波耶特、罗比·迪马特奥和丹尼斯·怀斯，以及前面的弗兰科·佐拉和休西。”勒索于 1987 年从泽西岛加盟时，加入了一支截然不同的切尔西球队。在这些欧洲超级巨星在场外拥有独特的性格和世界一流的品质之前，格雷姆发现自己很难融入另一个切尔西。 “这确实是一个充满敌意的环境，”他回忆道。 “俱乐部正在经历一段艰难的时期，约翰·霍林斯在我加入后不久就被解雇了——当时的情况很艰难。你必须有坚强的性格才能在那种氛围中生存。 “因为俱乐部降级了，每个人都在为自己着想，某些球员群体占据了主导地位，所以这是非常政治化的。对于一名想要发展的年轻球员来说，这总是很困难。”但对于年轻的勒索克斯来说，这并不全是厄运和沮丧，他在泽西岛期间被推荐给霍林斯颁发该岛年度最佳球员奖。可以说，他到来时俱乐部最优秀的人才是左后卫托尼·多里戈，这为他提供了磨练自己的技能并向国际足球运动员学习的理想机会。 “托尼强迫自己进入英格兰队，从我的角度来看，我没有机会进入球队，而替补是克莱夫·威尔逊，他是另一位出色的球员。他们是两个非常好的人，但我只是低着头，在预备队中尽力而为。 “你从周围的人身上学到了很多东西，尽管环境很艰难，但也有一些非常好的影响。我不仅学习了足球，还学习了在伦敦的生活，并在远离家乡的地方发现自己。我来自一个小岛，正在寻找伦敦的魅力。这是一个相当不稳定的时期，但球场上同样非常令人兴奋。 “我的第一场重要比赛记忆是当我们在斯坦福桥对阵热刺时，我对阵一直为英格兰队效力的特里·芬威克。我打了一场非常好的比赛，除了进球之外我什么都做了。 记得那场比赛的人仍然说那是我最好的一场比赛——那是我出场并给人留下了深刻印象的时候。”在90/91赛季最终融入球队后，勒索经常踢中场左侧，他很难占据自己的位置。他回忆道，“我没有一个位置可以让主教练说：‘好吧，那就是你踢球的地方’，这加剧了不一致。” “但这有助于我作为一名足球运动员的发展，因为最终我在布莱克本队和随后的英格兰队中以进攻型边后卫的身份出名，在那里我担任左后卫、边卫和中场左侧，在不同的体系中踢球。”当大卫·韦伯于1993年接任斯坦福桥主教练时，这种多才多艺并没有给他留下深刻的印象。这位前防守中坚分子带着新鲜的想法来到了俱乐部，而勒索并不属于这些想法。在韦伯执教切尔西后，这位前途无量的左后卫几乎立即被卖给了布莱克本，他离开时决心向那个如此迅速抛弃他的人证明自己的观点。 “韦伯是六年来我在切尔西的第四位主教练，这表明俱乐部有多么不稳定，”勒索指出。 “他接手后，看了我半场比赛，就认定我是垃圾。他基本上是说他认为我没有未来。我证明他错了，不是吗！”勒索在转会至布莱克本后很快就发现自己跻身国际舞台。到了1994/95赛季，他直接进入了肯尼·达格利什新组建的球队，并在特里·维纳布尔斯的英格兰队中获得了一席之地。 1995年，正值巅峰时期的勒索随流浪者队夺得英超冠军，并被许多业内人士视为该国最好的边后卫。但随着达格利什离开，布莱克本的气氛很快就恶化了，球队的领导力也有所下降。在其他地方，随着霍德尔和古利特的到来，在他以前的西伦敦主场，一个新时代即将到来，预示着新大陆切尔西将在不久的将来争夺荣誉。随着古力特进入管理层，董事会向他提供了资金，以进一步改善切尔西足总杯冠军阵容。只有最好的就足够了，随着斯科特·明托的离开，左后卫出现了空缺。 1997年8月，他又回到了他如此生动地描述的人物身边，他在古利特手下工作很开心。但正如 1987 年霍林斯的情况一样，勒索签约后不久，主帅就与切尔西分道扬镳。 “我曾经送行过几位主帅，”他开玩笑说。 “路德被解雇了，卢卡接手了，我们在他的带领下取得了成功，但在路德的团队下。这有点扰乱了俱乐部的平​​衡和方向，因为如果你看看最好的俱乐部，他们的管理具有一致性，我只是认为这让球员与主教练之间有了理解。”不过幸运的是，吉安卢卡·维亚利能够在相对较小的动荡下接手球队，因为他曾是古力特手下的俱乐部球员。意大利人在担任主教练期间赢得了五座奖杯，尽管勒索克斯对错失的机会有记忆。 “我没有参加优胜者杯决赛，因为三四个星期前我小腿受伤，”他说。 “我和他们一起参加了决赛之前的每一场比赛，所以我赢得了优胜者杯，如果你愿意的话。 “半决赛在桥上与维琴察的比赛很特别，气氛也很棒。当球迷们准备好比赛时，那个地方就震动了，切尔西球迷在客场如此喧闹，他们总是给我留下深刻的印象。 “当斯坦福桥的比赛开始时，气氛非常好——通常有一种非常积极的气氛，球迷们明白我们已经尽力了，那些年我们在主场取得了非常好的战绩。”当他错过了2000年成功的足总杯决赛时，更多的挫败感随之而来。“在布莱克本脚踝骨折后，我错过了那个赛季的大部分时间，”他回忆道。 “我的脚踝做了两次手术，花了九到十个月才恢复。 “所以这对我个人来说是糟糕的一年，因为我们开局不错，在冠军联赛中踢了一些精彩的比赛，最引人注目的是在土耳其对阵加拉塔萨雷的比赛中，我们以 5-0 击败了他们。 他们在那个赛季以不败的成绩赢得了联盟杯，这表明了这是多么伟大的成就。”维亚利在2000/01赛季开局不佳后继续前进，一个新的时代就被迎来了，对于那一代深受喜爱的蓝军来说，一切都开始结束了。 “克劳迪奥·拉涅利接手后，我们真的失去了动力，因为他让球队分裂了，”勒索回忆道。 “作为引进年轻球员的过渡的一部分，他可能不得不离开一些球员，但他这样做的方式破坏了我们前进的势头，所以我们无法在他的帮助下赢得任何东西。”旧的秩序以怀斯、波耶特和勒伯夫的形式消失了，而进来的却是一大堆成功率参差不齐的签约。不过，勒索仍然留在这里，当我们在 2002/2003 年的最后一天戏剧性地战胜利物浦重返冠军联赛时，他仍然在这里——这也被证明是他为切尔西效力的最后一场比赛。对于这位 16 年前来到这里的新鲜岛民来说，这是他精彩的蓝调生涯的一个恰当的结局。 - 本文的一个版本于 2006 年首次发表

news.title: Premier League 2 report: Stoke City 1-2 Cobham Next Gen
news.title_zh: 英超第二轮报告：斯托克城 1-2 科巴姆下一代
news.body_en: Chelsea Cobham Next Gen came from behind to claim a dramatic stoppage-time victory over Stoke City in Premier League 2, with an own goal forced by a Reggie Watson earning all three points. The Blues had the better chances in the opening exchanges, including a Chizaram Ezenwata shot that was cleared off the line, but fell behind in the 24th minute when Tristan Achu found the net. We responded quickly, though, as Justin Osagie turned inside and fired home, meaning the sides were level at the interval. The search was on for a winner in the second period. With 94 minutes on the clock, the Blues found it. Watson stepped up and whipped a free-kick over the wall and against the post. Fortunately, the rebound stuck goalkeeper Lucas Knight and ended in the Stoke net to spark wild celebrations. Stoke struck first in the game through Achu, who drove inside from the right wing and placed the ball into the bottom left corner. We had enjoyed the better chances at that point, but found ourselves on the back foot. The Blues' best chance before Stoke's opener had come from Ezenwata, who had his shot cleared off the line after excellent work from Mathis Eboue. The winger breezed beyond a defender and cut the ball across the face of goal for Ezenwata, who was unfortunately denied. We didn't have to wait long for an equaliser once behind, though, as Osagie scored five minutes after we conceded. The equaliser capped an impressive first-half display from Osagie, who dominated in the heart of the Chelsea defence and dealt confidently with Stoke’s long balls, winning the majority of his aerial duels. We pushed to go ahead following the restart, but were unable to gain a real foothold in the game. Stoke had rarely tested Freddy Bernal in the Chelsea goal, but when called upon, the Blues stopper did what was needed to deny the home side. Harrison Bettoni created a good opportunity for the Blues when he picked up possession in an advanced area and lofted the ball over to Eboue on the left wing. He opted to come inside on this occasion and curled his shot goalwards. Although his effort troubled Knight, it didn't beat the Stoke goalkeeper. The Blues enjoyed the majority of possession in the latter stages and sent plenty of crosses into the box. And following the substitution of Kendry Paez for Eboue, Sol Gordon was moved to the left wing and caused all kinds of trouble for the opposition full-back. In the dying minutes, he created two great opportunities to nick the winner. The first saw Gordon slide a pass inside to Yisa Alao, who rattled the crossbar with his first-time strike. The second came seconds later, but Ezenwata’s header went just wide. Osagie was in search of his second and lined up a strike from 20 yards out. However, he was taken down, earning the Blues a free-kick in a dangerous area. Watson stepped up and wrapped the strike towards the left corner. His effort hit the post, bounced off the back of Knight’s head, and ended in the Stoke net to give Chelsea a late winner and ensure we claimed another PL2 victory. This win lifts us to the top of Premier League 2 on 12 points, and we have now won our last four games on the spin in the league. Cobham Next Gen are back at Kingsmeadow on Saturday 24 October as we face Liverpool in the Premier League 2. Kick-off is at 2pm and supporters can watch the full match with a CFC+ subscription. Chelsea (3-4-3): Freddy Bernal; Alfie Osborne (Yisa Alao 69’), Justin Osagie, Tayo Subuloye (C); Reggie Watson, Harrison McMahon, Harrison Bettoni, Leo Black; Sol Gordon, Chizaram Ezenwata, Mathis Eboue (Kendry Paez 59’)Unused subs: Toby Bell, Dante Waite, Isaac Badu, Ibrahim Rabbaj, Heze GrimwadeScorers: Osagie 29’, Lucas Knight (OG) 90+4’Booked: Alao 88’, Watson 90+4’, Bettoni 90+6’ Stoke City (4-3-3): Lucas Knight; Anas Dauda, Rocco Bardsley, Raphael Otegbayo, Freddie Anderson; Jaden Mears (C), George Morrison, Finley Nixon; Tristan Achu, Adriel Walker, Elliot Fearn (Paul Makavore 67’, Thomas Midwood 76’)Unused subs: Tyler Martin, Oscar Hatton, Joshua McWilliams, Zachary Frost, Louie BradburyScorers: Achu 24’Booked: Adriel Walker 90+2’
news.body_zh: 切尔西科巴姆下一代队在英超第二轮补时阶段戏剧性地战胜斯托克城，雷吉·沃森逼迫乌龙球全取三分。蓝军在开场比赛中有更好的机会，包括奇扎拉姆·埃森瓦塔(Chizaram Ezenwata)的射门被挡出底线，但在第24分钟特里斯坦·阿楚(Tristan Achu)进球时落后。不过，我们反应很快，贾斯汀·奥萨吉转身内线射门，这意味着中场休息时双方持平。第二节比赛的获胜者正在寻找中。比赛还剩 94 分钟时，蓝军找到了机会。沃森挺身而出，任意球越过人墙击中立柱。幸运的是，篮板球卡住了门将卢卡斯·奈特，最后落入斯托克城的球门，引发了疯狂的庆祝活动。斯托克城本场比赛率先破门，阿楚从右翼内切，将球射入球门左下角。那时我们享受了更好的机会，但发现自己处于不利地位。斯托克城揭幕战前蓝军的最佳机会来自埃森瓦塔，在马蒂斯·埃布埃的出色表现后，埃森瓦塔的射门被挡出底线。这位边锋轻松越过一名后卫，将球切入埃森瓦塔球门，但不幸被挡出。不过，我们在落后的情况下并没有等太久就扳平比分，奥萨吉在我们失球五分钟后就进球了。扳平比分的进球为奥萨吉上半场令人印象深刻的表现画上了圆满的句号，他在切尔西的后防线中占据主导地位，并自信地处理斯托克城的长传，赢得了大部分的空中对抗。比赛重新开始后，我们力争继续前进，但未能在比赛中真正站稳脚跟。斯托克城很少在切尔西的进球中考验弗雷迪·伯纳尔，但当被要求时，这位蓝军门将做了必要的事情来阻止主队的进攻。哈里森·贝托尼在前场拿到控球权后将球传给了左翼的埃布埃，为蓝军创造了一次绝佳的机会。这次他选择内切并射向球门。尽管他的努力让奈特感到困扰，但并没有击败斯托克城的门将。蓝军在后半段占据了大部分控球权，并向禁区送出了大量传中。而随着肯德利·帕埃斯换下埃布埃，索尔·戈登被移至左翼，给对方边后卫制造了各种麻烦。在最后的几分钟里，他创造了两次绝妙的得分机会。第一个进球是戈登将球传给内线的伊萨·阿拉劳，后者的第一次射门击中了横梁。几秒钟后，第二个进球到来，但江泽渡的头球稍稍偏出。奥萨吉正在寻找他的第二个进球，并在 20 码外射门。然而，他被放倒，为蓝军赢得了危险区域的任意球。沃森挺身而出，将球打向左侧底角。他的射门击中门柱，从奈特的后脑勺弹回，最后入斯托克城的球门，为切尔西赢得了最后的制胜球，确保我们再次赢得联赛第二场胜利。这场胜利让我们以 12 分的成绩跃居英超第二联赛榜首，现在我们已经赢得了联赛最后四场比赛的胜利。 Cobham Next Gen 将于 10 月 24 日星期六回到 Kingsmeadow，我们将在英超 2 场比赛中对阵利物浦。开球时间为下午 2 点，支持者可以通过 CFC+ 订阅观看整场比赛。切尔西（3-4-3）：弗雷迪·伯纳尔；阿尔菲·奥斯本 (Yisa Alao 69’)、贾斯汀·奥萨吉 (Justin Osagie)、塔约·苏布洛耶 (Tayo Subuloye) (中)；雷吉·沃森、哈里森·麦克马洪、哈里森·贝托尼、里奥·布莱克；索尔·戈登、奇扎拉姆·埃森瓦塔、马西斯·埃布埃（肯德利·佩兹 59’）未上场替补：托比·贝尔、丹特·维特、艾萨克·巴杜、易卜拉欣·拉巴伊、赫兹·格里姆瓦德进球者：奥萨吉 29’、卢卡斯·奈特（OG）90+4’黄牌：阿劳 88’、沃森 90+4’、贝托尼 90+6’ 斯托克城(4-3-3)：卢卡斯·奈特；阿纳斯·道达、罗科·巴兹利、拉斐尔·奥特格巴约、弗雷迪·安德森；贾登·米尔斯（中）、乔治·莫里森、芬利·尼克松；特里斯坦·阿楚、阿德里尔·沃克、埃利奥特·费恩（保罗·马卡沃尔 67’、托马斯·米德伍德 76’）未上场替补：泰勒·马丁、奥斯卡·哈顿、约书亚·麦克威廉姆斯、扎卡里·弗罗斯特、路易·布拉德伯里得分：阿楚 24’ 黄牌：阿德里尔·沃克 90+2’

news.title: Alonso pleased ‘hungry’ and 'complete' Joao Pedro has taken next step at Chelsea
news.title_zh: 阿隆索很高兴“饥饿”和“完整”若昂·佩德罗在切尔西迈出了下一步
news.body_en: Xabi Alonso believes Joao Pedro can build on his excellent start to the season to cement his status as one of the Premier League’s top strikers and goalscorers. The Brazilian has found the back of the net five times in as many Premier League appearances this term - including a brace last time out in the 5-1 home win over Bournemouth - in addition to registering three assists in the top flight. Speaking ahead of our next fixture, away at Everton tomorrow, Alonso explained why he's been delighted with Joao Pedro’s form so far and is confident the 25-year-old can show the consistency to maintain that form throughout this season. ‘That's what we want, that’s what he wants,’ said the Chelsea manager. ‘It’s not just about right now that he has scored five goals. ‘From the first day of pre-season we spoke about that, the next step that he wanted, and he started really well with the pre-season and this season as well. So it's about continuing. ‘When you want to become a top striker in this league, you need to be ready in each game to have your impact. He's having it and we need that he keeps going. ‘So far, and before this, I could see him scoring lots of goals, and he's in a good moment. He will have a very good season because he's hungry for that and he's scoring goals. ‘He wants to be in the box and wants to help the team around the box as well. He's very complete. I really like the way he plays and the way he's connecting with his team-mates.’ Alonso knows he will need Joao Pedro and his fellow Blues in good form for tomorrow’s trip to the Hill Dickinson Stadium. Everton are currently one place ahead of Chelsea in the Premier League table, sitting fifth due to their narrowly better goal difference, and provide the kind of physical challenge that has caused the Blues difficulties in the past. ‘Absolutely it's a challenge for us to win one of these games, but for me all the games are tough,’ he added. ‘Bournemouth were tough and we won the game. ‘Each one is difficult, and away even more difficult. That's why tomorrow we know that we need to do many things right football-wise, competitive-wise, in terms of fights, duels, playing good with the ball. ‘So it will be very demanding and it's going to be challenging. For sure, we are aware of that.’
news.body_zh: 哈维·阿隆索相信若昂·佩德罗可以在本赛季的出色开局基础上巩固自己作为英超顶级前锋和射手之一的地位。巴西人本赛季在英超联赛中出场五次进球，包括上次主场5-1战胜伯恩茅斯的梅开二度，此外还在顶级联赛中贡献了3次助攻。在我们明天客场对阵埃弗顿的下一场比赛之前，阿隆索解释了为什么他对若昂·佩德罗迄今为止的状态感到满意，并相信这位 25 岁的球员能够在整个赛季保持这种状态的稳定性。 “这就是我们想要的，这就是他想要的，”切尔西主帅说道。 “这不仅仅是现在，他已经打进了五个进球。 “从季前赛的第一天起，我们就谈到了他想要的下一步，他在季前赛和本赛季的开局都非常好。所以这是关于继续。 “当你想成为联盟中的顶级前锋时，你需要在每场比赛中做好准备，以发挥自己的影响力。他已经做到了，我们需要他继续前进。 “到目前为止，以及在此之前，我可以看到他进了很多球，而且他正处于一个很好的时刻。他将会有一个非常好的赛季，因为他对此充满渴望并且他正在进球。 “他想要进入禁区，也想在禁区周围帮助球队。他非常完整。我真的很喜欢他的比赛方式以及他与队友联系的方式。阿隆索知道他需要若昂·佩德罗和他的蓝军同胞在明天前往希尔·迪金森体育场的比赛中保持良好的状态。埃弗顿目前在英超积分榜上领先切尔西一位，由于净胜球优势稍大，排名第五，并且提供了过去给蓝军带来困难的体能挑战。 “赢得其中一场比赛对我们来说绝对是一个挑战，但对我来说，所有比赛都很艰难，”他补充道。 “伯恩茅斯很艰难，我们赢了比赛。 “每一场比赛都很困难，客场比赛更加困难。这就是为什么明天我们知道我们需要在足球方面、在竞争方面、在战斗、决斗、打好球方面做正确的事情。 “所以这将是非常苛刻的，并且将是具有挑战性的。当然，我们知道这一点。

news.title: Key talking points from Sonia Bompastor's pre-Tottenham press conference
news.title_zh: 索尼娅·邦帕斯特托特纳姆热刺赛前新闻发布会的要点
news.body_en: Sonia Bompastor faced the media at Cobham ahead of our Women's Super League clash against Tottenham on Sunday, and here are the key talking points from what the Blues head coach said. Our players have all returned from international duty unscathed, and Bompastor confirmed she has a full squad to choose from for Sunday's match. We face a Spurs side that has enjoyed a largely positive start to the campaign, winning three of their opening five games. However, they did succumb to a heavy 6-1 defeat against London City Lionesses before the international break. The Blues, meanwhile, are looking to maintain our unbeaten start to the season, which has put us two points behind early WSL leaders Manchester City. 'We are playing them at kind of the same time as last season, when they were in a run of really good results. They had a good summer transfer window; they brought in really good players. 'Martin (Ho) is a really good coach, so we are expecting a tough game. We also know if we play with our quality, we can bring some challenges to them. 'I watched their game against London City. It was maybe one game where things didn't go the way they wanted, and it happens. I'm expecting a team that will bring us some challenges.' 'It's been the case in recent seasons that as soon as you start to drop points, it's not a good sign, because teams are performing. So every game is important, especially in this league. 'You need to make sure you stay at the top as long as possible. We know the game on Sunday will be tough, especially after the international break. 'You need to make sure you bring everyone back to your game model and that everyone is connected to the way we want to play as a team.' 'Lexi is doing well. I was glad she made her debut with England in the last game. I watched the game, and she is a player who is really confident with the ball, and she works really hard without the ball. I could see that with England as well. 'It's never easy to start for your country, especially when you play at home, and your family and your friends are at the game. It was great for her to get that exposure, and now it's really important for Lexi to keep working the way she's been working. 'She deserves everything that is happening to her. I know she's really humble, and she doesn't like to bring too much attention to herself. So please don't put too much pressure on her and keep her quiet – I think that's the best way she will continue to perform! 'She was pleased to come back to our environment, and I was pleased to see her again. She's back at a good level. She did well in this morning's training session.' 'We were in a really good place before the break. The main goal for us as a team and with the staff is to make sure we reconnect really quickly with the game model. We reconnect the players and staff together to perform at the same level as we were performing before the break. 'That's what we did yesterday and today. We have one more day tomorrow to prepare for the game, and I'm confident the players will have a good performance on Sunday.'
news.body_zh: 周日，我们的女足超级联赛对阵托特纳姆热刺队之前，索尼娅·邦帕斯特在科巴姆接受了媒体采访，以下是蓝军主教练所说的关键谈话要点。我们的球员都已从国际比赛中毫发无伤地返回，邦帕斯特证实她有完整的阵容可供选择参加周日的比赛。我们面对的是热刺队，他们在赛季开局基本积极，在前五场比赛中赢了三场。然而，他们在国际比赛日之前以 6-1 惨败于伦敦城狮队。与此同时，蓝军希望保持本赛季不败的开局，这让我们落后 WSL 早期领头羊曼城两分。 “我们和他们比赛的时间与上赛季差不多，当时他们取得了一系列非常好的成绩。他们有一个很好的夏季转会窗口；他们引进了非常优秀的球员。 “马丁（何）是一位非常优秀的教练，所以我们期待一场艰难的比赛。我们也知道，如果我们发挥自己的实力，我们可以给他们带来一些挑战。 “我观看了他们对阵伦敦城的比赛。这也许是一场比赛，事情并没有按照他们想要的方式发展，但它发生了。我期待一支能给我们带来挑战的球队。” “最近几个赛季的情况是，一旦你开始丢分，这不是一个好兆头，因为球队正在表现。所以每场比赛都很重要，尤其是在这个联盟中。 “你需要确保自己尽可能长时间地保持在顶端。我们知道周日的比赛将会很艰难，尤其是在国际比赛日之后。 “你需要确保让每个人都回到你的游戏模式，并且每个人都与我们想要的团队合作方式保持联系。” “莱克西表现得很好。我很高兴她在上一场比赛中首次代表英格兰队出场。我看了比赛，她是一个有球时非常自信的球员，无球时她也非常努力。我在英格兰队也能看到这一点。 “为你的国家队开始比赛从来都不是一件容易的事，尤其是当你在家里比赛，而你的家人和朋友都在比赛的时候。能够获得这样的曝光对她来说真是太棒了，现在对 Lexi 来说继续以她一直以来的方式工作真的很重要。 “发生在她身上的一切都是她应得的。我知道她很谦虚，不喜欢让自己受到太多关注。所以请不要给她太大的压力，让她保持安静——我想这是她继续表演的最好方式！ “她很高兴回到我们的环境，我很高兴再次见到她。她已经回到了一个很好的水平。她在今天早上的训练中表现很好。” “中场休息前我们的处境非常好。我们作为一个团队和员工的主要目标是确保我们能够快速地与游戏模型重新建立联系。我们将球员和工作人员重新联系在一起，以达到与休息前相同的水平。 “这就是我们昨天和今天所做的。明天我们还有一天的时间来准备比赛，我相信球员们在周日会有很好的表现。

news.title: Alonso: We have a good mix of personalities and leaders here
news.title_zh: 阿隆索：我们这里有很好的个性和领导者组合
news.body_en:
Xabi Alonso says the blend of characters, qualities and profiles in the Chelsea dressing room means his Blues squad is 'in a good place' to manage during Reece James’s recovery. 
 With James set for a spell on the sidelines after undergoing successful minor knee surgery, Alonso explained that Moises Caicedo or Levi Colwill, who wore the armband against Bournemouth last time out, are among those likely to skipper the side in the weeks ahead. Yet irrespective of who walks the team out on matchday, the Blues manager wants all his players to show leadership qualities throughout the week, on and off the pitch. He knows that is an important ingredient of teams achieving collective success; it should not just be down to one individual to lead the way. ‘You can be a captain without the armband,’ said Alonso. ‘Once you wear it, you have to be proud and take that responsibility. We have Moi, we have Levi, we have players that take that responsibility and perform the role in a perfect way. They have the support from the rest who see them with the armband, and it’s no problem. ‘But as well, having that leadership without the armband is important. That's why we have the ones that they need to pull from the rest, not just on matchday, even during the week, they need to deal with that.’ Alonso then expanded on the significance of a squad showcasing a breadth of leadership qualities depending on factors such as their experience in their game and their time at Chelsea. ‘Each one is different, and they bring their own personality,’ said Alonso. ‘Levi is different from Reece, Moi is different, Cole (Palmer), (Jordan) Hendo, Emi (Martinez), each one is different. ‘That's why it's so important for me to have a good mix of personalities, of qualities, of stages of their career  so that they can help - and we are in a good place in that way.’
news.body_zh:
哈比·阿隆索表示，切尔西更衣室的性格、素质和个人资料的融合意味着他的蓝军球队在里斯·詹姆斯康复期间处于“一个良好的位置”。 
 詹姆斯在成功接受膝盖小手术后将缺席一段时间，阿隆索解释说，上次对阵伯恩茅斯时佩戴队长袖标的莫伊塞斯·凯塞多或利维·科尔威尔可能会在未来几周担任球队队长。然而，无论谁在比赛日带领球队出局，蓝军主帅都希望他的所有球员在整个星期内，无论是场内还是场外，都能展现出领导才能。他知道这是团队取得集体成功的重要因素；不应该仅仅由一个人来领导。 “没有队长袖标你也可以成为队长，”阿隆索说道。 “一旦你穿上它，你就必须感到自豪并承担起责任。我们有莫伊，我们有列维，我们有承担这一责任并以完美方式扮演角色的球员。他们得到了其他看到他们戴上臂章的人的支持，这没有问题。 “但同样，在没有队长袖标的情况下拥有领导力也很重要。这就是为什么我们有他们需要从其他人中抽出的人，不仅仅是在比赛日，即使是在一周内，他们也需要处理这个问题。”阿隆索随后阐述了一支球队展示广泛领导才能的重要性，这取决于他们的比赛经验和在切尔西的时间等因素。 “每个人都是不同的，他们都有自己的个性，”阿隆索说。 ‘列维和里斯不同，莫伊不同，科尔（帕尔默）、（乔丹）亨多、埃米（马丁内斯），每个人都是不同的。 “这就是为什么对我来说如此重要的原因是，将他们的个性、品质和职业生涯阶段完美地结合起来，这样他们就能提供帮助——而我们在这方面处于一个很好的位置。”

news.title: Sonia Bompastor delivers Chelsea team news ahead of Tottenham
news.title_zh: 索尼娅·邦帕斯托在托特纳姆热刺赛前发布切尔西队新闻
news.body_en: Sonia Bompastor was pleased to report that she has the entire Chelsea squad to choose from for our Women's Super League match against Tottenham Hotspur on Sunday. Our internationals have returned to Cobham over the past couple of days after representing their countries across the world during the break – and they have been straight back to work as we prepare for a London derby this weekend. Bompastor's side welcome Spurs to Stamford Bridge on Sunday and will be aiming to continue our strong start to the WSL season: we have won four and drawn one of our opening five matches. We have been boosted in that ambition by the confirmation from the Blues head coach that there are no fitness concerns among her squad. 'The team is looking good,' she said. 'We had everyone back with a good level of fitness, and all the squad is available, so I'll have some headaches for the game on Sunday.'It's a great place to be, especially when you come into another busy block. I think when you're the head coach for Chelsea, this is where you want to be. 'You want to have headaches selecting your squad, your starting 11, and the players who are coming in to finish the game. So it's great and positive. 'We had a training session this morning and we have one more tomorrow, and the level of the training session was really good, so I'm glad and pleased to see that. Bompastor was asked specifically about the fitness of Lauren James, after the Blues forward scored twice for England in their 5-0 win over Greece at the King Power Stadium on Tuesday evening.  'She's fit,' the head coach replied.  'I think you could see that with England;  I'm glad she had two good games with England. She's in a good headspace and is performing at a good level.'She had a really good training session this morning, so that's good news for us.'
news.body_zh: 索尼娅·邦帕斯特 (Sonia Bompastor) 很高兴地报告说，她可以选择整支切尔西队参加周日对阵托特纳姆热刺队的女足超级联赛比赛。我们的国脚们在休息期间代表自己的国家出战后，在过去的几天里回到了科巴姆，在我们准备本周末的伦敦德比时，他们也直接回到了工作岗位。庞帕斯托的球队将于周日在斯坦福桥欢迎热刺，他们的目标是继续我们 WSL 赛季的强劲开局：我们在前五场比赛中赢了四场，打平了一场。蓝军主教练确认她的球队不存在体能问题，这增强了我们的雄心壮志。 “球队看起来不错，”她说。 “我们每个人都恢复了良好的健康水平，所有球队都可以上场，所以周日的比赛我会有些头疼。”这是一个很棒的地方，尤其是当你进入另一个繁忙的街区时。我认为当你担任切尔西主教练时，这就是你想去的地方。 “你会想要为选择你的阵容、你的首发11人以及即将上场完成比赛的球员而头痛。所以这是伟大而积极的。 “今天早上我们进行了一场训练，明天还有一场，训练的水平非常好，所以我很高兴看到这一点。周二晚上，蓝军前锋劳伦·詹姆斯在王权球场5-0战胜希腊的比赛中为英格兰队梅开二度，之后邦帕斯特被特别问及劳伦·詹姆斯的健康状况。  “她很健康，”主教练回答道。  “我想你可以在英格兰身上看到这一点；  我很高兴她在英格兰队打了两场精彩的比赛。她的头部空间很好，表现也很好。“她今天早上的训练非常好，所以这对我们来说是个好消息。”

news.title: Xabi Alonso on managing ‘emotional’ away games and formation flexibility
news.title_zh: 哈维·阿隆索谈管理“情绪化”客场比赛和阵型灵活性
news.body_en: Chelsea hit the road for the first time since our 3-0 defeat to Brentford as we travel to Everton tomorrow, and Xabi Alonso is determined to see his side deal with what he expects will be a ‘high-demand’ game. Our second visit to the Hill Dickinson Stadium comes following last weekend’s emphatic 5-1 win over Bournemouth. That victory was the perfect return to action after not only the prolonged international break, but also the disappointing result at the Gtech Stadium that preceded it. Against our west London neighbours, the Blues conceded three second-half goals to fall to defeat. There were lessons to be learned. And Alonso hopes that experience, while painful, will prove beneficial in what he expects will be a hostile environment at the Hill Dickinson Stadium ‘It’s going to be tough at Everton, but we are looking forward to the intensity of the game, a high-demand game, high tempo,’ said Alonso. ‘I haven't been in the stadium, but they've told me it's a nice one with good atmosphere, so we are looking forward to it. ‘I want that we compete and show what it takes to win away Premier League games in tough stadiums where the supporters create a great emotional energy. I want us to deal with that by playing, but by competing as well. For sure, the experience at Brentford is not forgotten.’ With 15 goals scored in our opening six top-flight games of the season, Alonso wants the Blues to stay proficient in the final third while shoring things up at the other end, which he has emphasised will increase our chances of winning challenging games, such as the one we can expect on Merseyside. Against Bournemouth, Alonso adjusted his side’s shape out of possession, with the Blues dropping back into a 4-4-2 formation. Our manager explained why he will remain flexible in how he sets his team up depending on the opposition, while noting certain elements of play matter more. He explained: ‘We want to be flexible, but we also want to be solid whenever we are pressing high, or a little bit lower. We need to think that the distances are right and that the balance is the right one, so we chose that way against Bournemouth. ‘Everton is going to be different. They do many good things and have very good players who have experience. So those principles are important. ‘It can be in a 4-4-2, it can be in a 5-2-3, but the distances, how you help and how you have a good balance, this is what you need to defend. After that, what you do with the ball is another thing.’
news.body_zh: 切尔西自 3-0 输给布伦特福德以来首次上路，明天我们将前往埃弗顿，哈维·阿隆索决心让他的球队应对他所期望的一场“高需求”的比赛。我们第二次造访希尔迪金森体育场是在上周末 5-1 战胜伯恩茅斯之后。这场胜利不仅是在漫长的国际比赛日之后的完美回归，也是在之前的 Gtech 体育场令人失望的结果之后的完美回归。对阵我们伦敦西部的邻居时，蓝军在下半场丢了三个球，最终落败。有一些教训值得吸取。阿隆索希望这段经历虽然痛苦，但在他预计希尔迪金森体育场的敌对环境中将是有益的。“在埃弗顿会很艰难，但我们期待比赛的强度，一场高要求的比赛，快节奏的比赛，”阿隆索说。 “我没有去过体育场，但他们告诉我这是一个很好的体育场，气氛很好，所以我们很期待。 “我希望我们能够在艰苦的体育场内竞争并展示如何赢得客场英超比赛，那里的球迷会产生巨大的情感能量。我希望我们通过比赛来解决这个问题，但也通过竞争来解决这个问题。当然，在布伦特福德的经历不会被忘记。”我们在本赛季的前六场顶级联赛中打进了15个进球，阿隆索希望蓝军在最后三分之一的比赛中保持熟练，同时在另一端支撑球队，他强调这将增加我们赢得具有挑战性的比赛的机会，例如我们可以在默西塞德郡期待的那场比赛。对阵伯恩茅斯的比赛中，阿隆索在控球后调整了球队的阵型，蓝军重新回到了4-4-2阵型。我们的经理解释了为什么他会根据对手的情况灵活地安排球队，同时指出比赛的某些要素更重要。他解释说：“我们希望保持灵活性，但每当我们压高或压低一点时，我们也希望保持稳定。我们需要认为距离是正确的，平衡是正确的，所以我们在对阵伯恩茅斯的比赛中选择了这种方式。 “埃弗顿将会有所不同。他们做了很多好事，并且拥有非常优秀、有经验的球员。所以这些原则很重要。 “可以是4-4-2阵型，也可以是5-2-3阵型，但是距离、如何提供帮助以及如何保持良好的平衡，这就是你需要防守的。之后，你如何处理球就是另一回事了。”

news.title: Premier League ticket news: Crystal Palace at home and Sunderland away
news.title_zh: 英超门票新闻：水晶宫主场、桑德兰客场
news.body_en: Ticket selling details have been announced for our first Premier League matches in November and December. The Blues travel to play Sunderland on Sunday 8 November with kick-off at 2pm. Applications can be made individually or as a group, provided all members of the group are eligible to apply during that window. Tickets will be allocated one per person with a maximum of four per application. As part of the verification process, a pre-authorisation charge £0.01 will be applied to validate your payment card. No money will be taken at this stage, and the hold will be removed by your provider. Tickets for this match are priced at Category A. Please click here for match ticket prices Tickets will appear on the Chelsea Official App prior to the event. Eligible members can submit their application through the official ticketing portal at any time during the window, supporters must ensure they are logged in to successfully apply. Applying earlier does not increase the likelihood of success, giving supporters greater flexibility to apply at a time that suits them. To ensure you are receiving the correct ticket, please take the time to check the date of birth on your account is accurate. You will only be allocated tickets in your selected areas unless you choose to be considered for other available options. news.title: Xabi Alonso confirms Chelsea team news for Everton
news.title_zh: 哈比·阿隆索确认了切尔西队为埃弗顿效力的消息
news.body_en: Xabi Alonso provided updates on the fitness of Emmanuel Emegha and Jamie Gittens ahead of our Premier League trip to Everton – and emphasised the influence Reece James will continue to have during his recovery from knee surgery. After returning to action with an impressive 5-1 win over Bournemouth at Stamford Bridge, we head out on the road this weekend, leaving London for the first time this season. Alonso confirmed before our journey to Merseyside that there were no fresh fitness concerns to highlight. However, Emegha and Gittens remain unavailable. On Emegha, the Blues manager explained: 'He is not ready for tomorrow; he felt something yesterday (Thursday), a little thing. He is going to be training next week, but he's still not 100 per cent fit to be playing in the game [against Everton].' The Dutch forward has yet to make his debut for the Blues after his summer arrival from Strasbourg, but Alonso expects the 23-year-old to have a big impact when he is fit and available. He said: 'When he is fit, he is very special. He is 1.95 metres, is quick, he attacks space, and he is a threat. He needs to be fully fit and at this moment he’s had little things, and unfortunately has not been available. 'But we are looking forward to him feeling good and helping the team, and it's going to be difficult for defenders when he is in good shape. Gittens, meanwhile, suffered an injury while on international duty with England Under-21s and Alonso confirmed there is no date pencilled in for the winger's return. 'Not yet, it’s still a few weeks,' he said. It was confirmed this morning that James had undergone surgery on a knee injury sustained in training last Friday. There is no timeframe for the Blues skipper's return, but Alonso says the 26-year-old will remain a key presence in the dressing room. ‘We are all disappointed, and especially for him,' said Alonso. 'He wanted to have a good start after the international break, but in the last training session he picked up an injury. We wanted to be cautious and wait for the result of the tests. 'Now, the surgery has been successful and we will keep supporting him. He will be close to the team as he is a great influence even when he is not available. We wish him a great recovery and while we don’t set timelines, he will be out for several weeks. ‘He is so proud to be playing for this club, and he is so proud to have reached this moment [in his career] because he has played many years and gone through many different stages. 'So he takes that responsibility in a very natural way, with his own way of leadership. He is so respected by his team-mates and he has the support of everyone.'
news.body_zh: 在我们前往埃弗顿的英超联赛之前，哈比·阿隆索提供了伊曼纽尔·埃梅加和杰米·吉滕斯的最新健康状况信息，并强调了里斯·詹姆斯在膝盖手术恢复期间将继续产生的影响。在斯坦福桥以 5-1 击败伯恩茅斯的令人印​​象深刻的比赛后，我们本周末将启程前往客场，这是本赛季首次离开伦敦。阿隆索在前往默西塞德郡之前证实，没有新的健康问题需要强调。然而，Emegha 和 Gittens 仍然无法使用。在谈到埃梅加时，蓝军主帅解释道：“他还没有为明天做好准备；他已经做好了准备。”昨天（星期四）他感觉到了一些东西，一件小事。他将于下周进行训练，但他仍然没有百分百适合参加（对阵埃弗顿的）比赛。这位荷兰前锋在夏季从斯特拉斯堡抵达后尚未为蓝军首次亮相，但阿隆索预计这位 23 岁的球员在健康和可用时会产生巨大影响。他说：“当他健康的时候，他是非常特别的。他身高1.95米，速度快，攻击空间大，是一个威胁。他需要完全恢复健康，目前他的身体状况不佳，不幸的是还没有上场。 “但我们期待他感觉良好并帮助球队，当他状态良好时，后卫会很困难。与此同时，吉滕斯在英格兰21岁以下国家队比赛中受伤，阿隆索证实这位边锋的回归日期还没有确定。 “还没有，还有几周的时间，”他说。今天早上证实，詹姆斯因上周五训练中膝盖受伤接受了手术。目前还没有蓝军队长回归的时间表，但阿隆索表示，这位 26 岁的球员仍将是更衣室的关键人物。 “我们都很失望，尤其是对他，”阿隆索说。 “他希望在国际比赛日后能有一个好的开局，但在最后一次训练中他受伤了。我们想保持谨慎并等待测试结果。现在，手术已经成功，我们将继续支持他。他将与球队保持密切联系，因为即使他不在场，他也会产生巨大的影响力。我们祝愿他康复，虽然我们没有设定时间表，但他将缺席几周的时间。 “他非常自豪能够为这家具乐部效力，他也非常自豪能够达到[职业生涯]的这一刻，因为他已经踢了很多年，经历了许多不同的阶段。 “所以他以一种非常自然的方式和他自己的领导方式承担了这一责任。他深受队友的尊重，也得到了所有人的支持。”

news.title: Reggie Watson on his 'superpower' and Player of the Month win
news.title_zh: 雷吉·沃森谈他的“超能力”和本月最佳球员
news.body_en: It’s been a season full of memorable moments for Reggie Watson, who has already made his senior debut for Chelsea, captained England Under-17s and won the Premier League 2 Player of the Month award. Watson has stepped up to the Cobham Next Gen squad this season at just 16 years old and has been key to the Blues’ impressive start. He has been rewarded for his form and is looking to progress even further as the campaign progresses. We sat down with Watson to speak about the season so far and what’s to come from him and the CNG team in 2026/27. After returning from international duty, Watson was presented with his PL2 Player of the Month award for September 2026. He won the award after scoring three goals in two matches, taking him up to five in all competitions. Reflecting on the accolade, Watson said: ‘It’s been a great start, we are near the top of the table and there’s been some great performances from myself and by the team. We’ve got some good results and hopefully we can just push on. I think I’ve done well, winning Player of the Month shows I’ve stepped up to the level. ‘I’ve been very pleased. Scoring five goals is quite nice, I don’t think I’ve scored that many in my life but hopefully we can just push on even more with some even better performances.’ Those goals included a stunning free-kick against Arsenal. Watson described his striking ability from dead-ball situations as one of his ‘superpowers’. He said: ‘I practise them quite a lot, but it was natural when I was younger. Once I started working on it with some coaches they have helped make them even better. It’s become a superpower of mine.’ At such an early stage in his career, Watson has shown great maturity in adapting to Under-21s football and senior football. He has impressed under Cobham Next Gen head coach Harry Hudson in the league and cup competitions, becoming a key cog in the Blues' midfield. Speaking on working under Hudson and the CNG training environment, Watson revealed: ‘I enjoy it, when I have trained with them it’s been fun and in the games we’ve showed our levels. ‘It’s very competitive and we have a good relationship on the pitch. It shows in games this season when we’ve gone behind and we’ve stepped up. It demands a high level every single day and being an overall complete player.’ Throughout his time with Chelsea, Watson has continued to maintain those high standards and it has led to him being involved with the first team. In fact, after spending time with the senior squad during pre-season, Watson was able to make his competitive debut when he started against Leeds United in the Carabao Cup. 'It was a crazy moment. I was quite nervous the day before because I didn’t really know if I was going to play at all. Once I found out I was starting, I was kind of shocked, but confident. 'Walking out onto the pitch I got crazy goosebumps seeing all the fans and the atmosphere. Starting for Chelsea at 16 is such an honour, I think I was ready for it though. 'There are some big characters in the first team who help the young boys out and when you look around you see talented players everywhere. I was shocked because it’s like: “Wow, I’m playing with these players”.’ Watson’s senior debut made him the youngest player to ever feature for Chelsea in the Carabao Cup, although it wasn’t his first taste of senior football for the Blues. He was also part of the first-team squad who went out to Australia and Asia for our pre-season tour. Watson said: ‘The first game I started and played the full game which I didn’t expect. Training sessions with the first team were very valuable.’ Watson was called up for the England Under-17s squad during the last international window and captained the Young Lions in their matches against the Republic of Ireland, Israel, Venezuela and Germany. Looking back on the experience, the midfielder said: ‘It’s very competitive when you play for England, as you would expect playing for your country and playing against some top nations. It’s probably the biggest pride in football, captaining your country, it’s an honour.’ Across all competitions, Watson has found the back of the net on five occasions for Cobham Next Gen. The squad have some big tests ahead, but Watson is relishing the opportunity to face any challenge that comes his way and aims to ‘win everything’. ‘I’m very excited, I think we can get wins. I’m hoping for solid performances and maybe I can chip in with a few goals again,’ he said. His next opportunity to do so arrives this evening, when we travel to Stoke City for a 7pm kick-off in the Premier League 2. CFC+ subscribers can watch the game live on the Chelsea Official App and website, with highlights available to all supporters the following day.
news.body_zh: 对于雷吉·沃森来说，这是一个充满难忘时刻的赛季，他已经在切尔西完成了自己的成年队首秀，担任英格兰 17 岁以下国家队队长，并赢得了英超联赛 2 月最佳球员奖。沃森本赛季年仅 16 岁就加入了科巴姆下一代队，并且是蓝军取得令人印象深刻的开局的关键。他因其出色的表现而获得了奖励，并希望随着竞选的进展取得进一步的进步。我们与 Watson 坐下来讨论了本赛季迄今为止的情况以及他和 CNG 团队在 2026/27 年的发展。从国家队归来后，沃森被授予 2026 年 9 月 PL2 月度最佳球员奖。他在两场比赛中攻入 3 个进球，使他在所有比赛中的进球数上升到 5 个。谈到这一荣誉，沃森表示：“这是一个很好的开始，我们已经接近积分榜榜首，我自己和团队都表现出色。”我们已经取得了一些不错的成绩，希望我们能够继续前进。我认为我做得很好，赢得本月最佳球员表明我已经达到了水平。 ‘我已经非常高兴了。进五个球非常好，我不认为我一生中进过那么多球，但希望我们能够以更好的表现继续前进。”这些进球包括对阵阿森纳的惊人任意球。沃森将他在死球情况下的打击能力描述为他的“超能力”之一。他说：“我经常练习它们，但在我年轻的时候这是很自然的。当我开始与一些教练一起工作时，他们帮助我变得更好。它已经成为我的超能力。”在职业生涯的早期阶段，沃森在适应 21 岁以下足球和成年足球方面就表现出了极大的成熟。在科巴姆下一代主教练哈里·哈德森的带领下，他在联赛和杯赛中给人留下了深刻的印象，成为蓝军中场的关键一环。谈到在哈德森和 CNG 训练环境下的工作，沃森透露：“我很享受，当我和他们一起训练时，这很有趣，在比赛中我们展示了我们的水平。” “竞争非常激烈，我们在球场上有着良好的关系。这在本赛季的比赛中体现出来，当我们落后时，我们会奋起直追。这要求每天都保持高水平，并成为一名全面的球员。”在切尔西效力期间，沃森一直保持着这些高标准，这使得他能够加入一线队。事实上，在季前赛与一线队一起度过一段时光后，沃森在卡拉宝杯对阵利兹联的比赛中首发出场，完成了他的正式比赛首秀。 “那是一个疯狂的时刻。前一天我非常紧张，因为我真的不知道自己是否会参加比赛。当我发现自己要开始时，我有点震惊，但充满信心。 “当我走上球场，看到所有的球迷和气氛时，我起鸡皮疙瘩。 16 岁就为切尔西首发真是一种荣幸，不过我想我已经做好了准备。 “一线队中有一些大人物帮助年轻球员走出困境，当你环顾四周时，你会发现到处都有才华横溢的球员。我很震惊，因为这就像：“哇，我正在和这些球员一起踢球”。沃森的成年队首秀使他成为切尔西在联赛杯中出场的最年轻的球员，尽管这并不是他第一次为蓝军成年队踢球。他也是前往澳大利亚和亚洲参加我们季前赛的一线队的一员。沃森说：“第一场比赛我首发并打满了比赛，这是我没想到的。与一线队的训练非常有价值。沃森在上个国际比赛窗口期间被征召入英格兰 17 岁以下国家队，并在对阵爱尔兰共和国、以色列、委内瑞拉和德国的比赛中担任青年狮队队长。回顾这段经历，这位中场球员说道：“当你为英格兰队效力时，竞争非常激烈，因为你会期望为自己的国家队效力，并与一些顶级国家队比赛。”为你的国家队担任队长可能是足球界最大的骄傲，这是一种荣誉。”在所有比赛中，沃森已经为科巴姆下一代队五次破门。球队即将面临一些重大考验，但沃森很高兴有机会面对他遇到的任何挑战，并致力于“赢得一切”。 “我非常兴奋，我认为我们能够取得胜利。我希望能有稳定的表现，也许我可以再次进球，”他说。 他的下一次机会将在今晚到来，届时我们将前往斯托克城参加英超 2 场比赛晚上 7 点的开球。CFC+ 订阅者可以在切尔西官方应用程序和网站上观看比赛直播，第二天所有支持者均可观看精彩集锦。

news.title: Injury update: Reece James
news.title_zh: 伤病更新：里斯·詹姆斯
news.body_en: Chelsea Football Club has released the following update regarding Reece James... Captain Reece James has undergone successful minor knee surgery. The 26-year-old was absent from Saturday’s 5-1 victory over Bournemouth at Stamford Bridge while medical assessments took place following the injury suffered in training. Those assessments confirmed surgery would be the required course of action. Reece has already begun his road to recovery and will be supported by the club's medical department at Cobham during this rehabilitation phase. Everyone at Chelsea wishes Reece a speedy recovery and will support him on his road to return.
news.body_zh: 切尔西足球俱乐部发布了有关里斯·詹姆斯的以下更新……队长里斯·詹姆斯已经成功接受了小膝盖手术。这位26岁的球员缺席了周六在斯坦福桥5-1战胜伯恩茅斯的比赛，同时在训练中受伤后进行了医疗评估。这些评估证实手术将是必要的行动方案。里斯已经开始了康复之路，在此康复阶段将得到位于科巴姆的俱乐部医疗部门的支持。切尔西的每个人都祝愿里斯早日康复，并在他的回归之路上支持他。

news.title: Experience the ultimate Chelsea FC weekend
news.title_zh: 体验终极切尔西足球俱乐部周末
news.body_en: There are few places in football more iconic than the Chelsea home dressing room. On the eve of Chelsea's highly anticipated Premier League fixture against Manchester United, a select group of just 30 guests will have the rare opportunity to step inside this exclusive inner sanctum of Stamford Bridge for an unforgettable evening unlike any other. Ordinarily reserved for the squad's final preparations before kick-off, the home dressing room will be transformed into an intimate dining venue, offering guests a unique chance to experience the club from a completely different perspective. The evening begins with a champagne reception before guests are treated to a carefully curated three-course dining experience, accompanied by a complimentary bar. Throughout the night, attendees will also enjoy exclusive behind-the-scenes access to Stamford Bridge, including the opportunity to view some of Chelsea Football Club's most celebrated silverware up close. The following day, guests will return to Stamford Bridge as Chelsea and Manchester United, two of English football's most storied clubs, go head to head in one of the standout fixtures of the season. Watching the action unfold from premium hospitality provides the perfect conclusion to an extraordinary footballing weekend. Combining exceptional dining, exclusive access and the electric atmosphere of elite Premier League football, this two-day experience has been designed to bring supporters closer to the club than ever before. With places strictly limited to just 30 guests, this is a rare opportunity to experience Chelsea Football Club in a way few ever will. For guests seeking a standalone experience, the exclusive dining event can also be enjoyed independently, offering a unique opportunity to step inside the iconic home dressing room and indulge in an unforgettable evening at Stamford Bridge on the eve of the match. - Click to book with Club Chelsea Matchday Experiences
